bukhari.description: Al-Jami' al-Musnad al-Sahih. Regarded as the most authentic book after the Qur'an.
bukhari.edition: Dar Tawq al-Najat, 1422 AH, ed. Muhammad Zuhayr al-Nasir (Sultaniyya print, Fu'ad 'Abd al-Baqi numbering), 9 vols

books.name_en: Rubbing hands and feet with dust (Tayammum)
Virtues of Prayer at Masjid Makkah and Madinah
books.name_ar: كتاب فضل الصلاة فى مسجد مكة والمدينة

books.name_en: Pilgrims Prevented from Completing the Pilgrimage
Penalty of Hunting while on Pilgrimage
Virtues of the Night of Qadr
Retiring to a Mosque for Remembrance of Allah (I'tikaf)
Sales in which a Price is paid for Goods to be Delivered Later (As-Salam)
Transferance of a Debt from One Person to Another (Al-Hawaala)
Loans, Payment of Loans, Freezing of Property, Bankruptcy
Lost Things Picked up by Someone (Luqatah)
Fighting for the Cause of Allah (Jihaad)
One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)
Virtues and Merits of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions

books.name_ar: كتاب فضائل أصحاب النبى صلى الله عليه وسلم

books.name_en: Merits of the Helpers in Madinah (Ansaar)
Military Expeditions led by the Prophet (pbuh) (Al-Maghaazi)
Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh))
Limits and Punishments set by Allah (Hudood)
Afflictions and the End of the World
Accepting Information Given by a Truthful Person
Holding Fast to the Qur'an and Sunnah

chapters.name_en: How the Divine Revelation started being revealed to Allah's Messenger
chapters.name_ar: كَيْفَ كَانَ بَدْءُ الْوَحْىِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم

chapters.name_en: Your invocation means your faith
chapters.name_ar: دُعَاؤُكُمْ إِيمَانُكُمْ

chapters.name_en: (What is said) regarding the deeds of faith
chapters.name_ar: أُمُورِ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: A Muslim is the one who avoids harming Muslims with his tongue and hands
chapters.name_ar: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ

chapters.name_en: Whose Islam is the best (Who is the best Muslim)?
chapters.name_ar: أَىُّ الإِسْلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ

chapters.name_en: To feed (others) is a part of Islam
chapters.name_ar: إِطْعَامُ الطَّعَامِ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ

chapters.name_en: To like for one's (Muslim's) brother what one likes for himself is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: مِنَ الإِيمَانِ أَنْ يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

chapters.name_en: To love the Messenger (Muhammad saws) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: حُبُّ الرَّسُولِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: Sweetness (delight) of faith
chapters.name_ar: حَلاَوَةِ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: To love the Ansar is a sign of faith
chapters.name_ar: عَلاَمَةُ الإِيمَانِ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ
باب: علامة الإيمان حب الأنصار

chapters.name_en: To flee (run away) from Al-Fitn (afflictions and trials), is a part of religion
chapters.name_ar: مِنَ الدِّينِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ

chapters.name_en: The statement of the Prophet (saws): "I know Allah Ta'ala better, than all of you do."
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏«أَنَا أَعْلَمُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ»

chapters.name_en: Whoever hates to revert to Kufr
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي الْكُفْرِ كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُلْقَى فِي النَّارِ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: The grades in superiority of the believers will be according to their good deeds
chapters.name_ar: تَفَاضُلِ أَهْلِ الإِيمَانِ فِي الأَعْمَالِ

chapters.name_en: Al-Haya (self-respect, modesty bashfulness, honour etc.) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: الْحَيَاءُ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: (The Statement of Allah Jalla Jalalahu) "But if they repent [by rejecting Shirk (polytheism) and accept Islamic Monotheism] and  perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat) and give Zakat then leave their way free."
chapters.name_ar: {فَإِنْ تَابُوا وَأَقَامُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَآتَوُا الزَّكَاةَ فَخَلُّوا سَبِيلَهُمْ}

chapters.name_en: Whoever says that faith is action (good deeds)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ قَالَ إِنَّ الإِيمَانَ هُوَ الْعَمَلُ

chapters.name_en: If one does not embrace Islam truly but does so by compulsion or for fear of being killed (then that man is not a believer)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنِ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى الْحَقِيقَةِ وَكَانَ عَلَى الاِسْتِسْلاَمِ أَوِ الْخَوْفِ مِنَ الْقَتْلِ

chapters.name_en: To greet is a part of Islam
chapters.name_ar: إِفْشَاءُ السَّلاَمِ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ

chapters.name_en: To be ungrateful to one's husband. And disbelief is of (different grades) lesser (or greater) degrees.
chapters.name_ar: كُفْرَانِ الْعَشِيرِ وَكُفْرٍ دُونَ كُفْرٍ

chapters.name_en: Sins are from ignorance and a sinner is not a disbeliever unless he worships others along with Allah 'Azza wa Jall
chapters.name_ar: الْمَعَاصِي مِنْ أَمْرِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ

chapters.name_en: "And if two parties (or groups) from among the believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them both…" Allah has called them "believers"
chapters.name_ar: {وَإِنْ طَائِفَتَانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَهُمَا} فَسَمَّاهُمُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ

chapters.name_en: Dhulm (wrong) of one kind can be greater or lesser than that of another
chapters.name_ar: ظُلْمٌ دُونَ ظُلْمٍ

chapters.name_en: The signs of a hypocrite
chapters.name_ar: عَلاَمَةِ الْمُنَافِقِ

chapters.name_en: To establish the (Nawafil - voluntary) prayers on the night of Qadr is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: قِيَامُ لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: Al-Jihad (fighting tn Allah's Cause) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: الْجِهَادُ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: It is a part of faith to establish the (Nawafil — voluntary) prayers during the nights of Ramadan
chapters.name_ar: تَطَوُّعُ قِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: To observe fasting (according to Islamic teachings)] during the month of Ramadan (sincerely and faithfully) hoping for Allah's Reward only, is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: صَوْمُ رَمَضَانَ احْتِسَابًا مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: Religion is very easy
chapters.name_ar: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ

chapters.name_en: The (offering of) Salat (prayers) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةُ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said regarding the superiority of) a person who embraces Islam sincerely.
chapters.name_ar: حُسْنِ إِسْلاَمِ الْمَرْءِ

chapters.name_en: Ad-Din (good, righteous deed - act of worship) loved most by Allah Jalla Jalalahu is that which is done regularly. (And in fact the best religion with Allah is Islam)
chapters.name_ar: أَحَبُّ الدِّينِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهُ

chapters.name_en: Faith increases and decreases
chapters.name_ar: زِيَادَةِ الإِيمَانِ وَنُقْصَانِهِ

chapters.name_en: To pay Zakat is a part of Islam
chapters.name_ar: الزَّكَاةُ مِنَ الإِسْلاَمِ

chapters.name_en: To accompany the funeral processions (up to the place of burial) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: اتِّبَاعُ الْجَنَائِزِ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said regarding) the fear of a believer that his good deeds may be annulled (lost) without his knowledge
chapters.name_ar: خَوْفِ الْمُؤْمِنِ مِنْ أَنْ يَحْبَطَ عَمَلُهُ وَهُوَ لاَ يَشْعُرُ

chapters.name_en: The asking of (angel) Jibrll (Gabriel) from the Prophet (saws) about Iman, Islam, Ihsan and the knowledge of the Hour
chapters.name_ar: سُؤَالِ جِبْرِيلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنِ الإِيمَانِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ وَالإِحْسَانِ وَعِلْمِ السَّاعَةِ
باب سؤال جبريل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم عن الإيمان، والإسلام، والإحسان، وعلم الساعة

chapters.name_en: The superiority of that person who leaves all doubtful (unclear) things for the sake of his religion
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ مَنِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ

chapters.name_en: To pay Al-Khumus (one-fifth of the war booty to be given in Allah's Cause) is a part of faith
chapters.name_ar: أَدَاءُ الْخُمُسِ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: The statement of the Prophet (saws): Religion is An-Nasihah (to be sincere and true) to Allah, to His Messenger (Muhammad (saws)), to the Muslim rulers, and to all the Muslims
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ»

chapters.name_en: Whoever is asked about knowledge while he is busy in some conversation, so he finished talking and then answered the questioner
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ سُئِلَ عِلْمًا وَهُوَ مُشْتَغِلٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ فَأَتَمَّ الْحَدِيثَ ثُمَّ أَجَابَ السَّائِلَ

chapters.name_en: Whoever raises his voice in (conveying) knowledge
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ رَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ بِالْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: Concerning the variety of words used by narrators conveying different significations regarding the concept of narrating and which has importance for the Hadith scholars only
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ الْمُحَدِّثِ حَدَّثَنَا أَوْ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَأَنْبَأَنَا

chapters.name_en: The Imam questioning his companions in order to test their knowledge
chapters.name_ar: طَرْحِ الإِمَامِ الْمَسْأَلَةَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِهِ لِيَخْتَبِرَ مَا عِنْدَهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: What is said about knowledge
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: What is said regarding the hand to hand exchange (of books of knowledge), and the writing of knowledge by religious scholars to different countries
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُذْكَرُ فِي الْمُنَاوَلَةِ وَكِتَابِ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ بِالْعِلْمِ إِلَى الْبُلْدَانِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever sat at the farther end of a gathering. And whoever found a place amongst a gathering and took his seat there
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ قَعَدَ حَيْثُ يَنْتَهِي بِهِ الْمَجْلِسُ وَمَنْ رَأَى فُرْجَةً فِي الْحَلْقَةِ فَجَلَسَ فِيهَا‏.‏

chapters.name_en: The Statement of the Prophet (saws): lt is probable that a person who receives a piece of information indirectly may comprehend it better than he who has heard it directly from its source
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏رُبَّ مُبَلَّغٍ أَوْعَى مِنْ سَامِعٍ ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saws) used to take care of the people in preaching by selecting a suitable time so that they might not run away (never made them averse or bored them with religious talk and knowledge all the time)
chapters.name_ar: مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَخَوَّلُهُمْ بِالْمَوْعِظَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ كَىْ لاَ يَنْفِرُوا

chapters.name_en: Whoever fixed a special day for giving (a religious talk) to the students
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ جَعَلَ لأَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَيَّامًا مَعْلُومَةً

chapters.name_en: If Allah Jalla Jalalahu wants to do good to a person, He makes him comprehend (the religion). [The understanding of the Qur'an and As-Sunna (legal ways) of the Prophet (Muhammad (saws))]
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ

chapters.name_en: (The superiority of) comprehending knowledge
chapters.name_ar: الْفَهْمِ فِي الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: Wish to be like the one who has knowledge and Al-Hikmah [wisdom i.e., the knowledge of the Qur'an and the Sunna (legal ways) of the Prophet (saws)]
chapters.name_ar: الاِغْتِبَاطِ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ وَقَالَ عُمَرُ تَفَقَّهُوا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُسَوَّدُوا

chapters.name_en: What has been said about the journey of Prophet Musa ('alaihi as-salam) (when he went) in the sea to meet Al-Khidr
chapters.name_ar: مَا ذُكِرَ فِي ذَهَابِ مُوسَى صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْبَحْرِ إِلَى الْخَضِرِ

chapters.name_en: The statement of the Prophet (saws): "O Allah! Bestow on him (Ibn Abbas) the knowledge of the Book (the Qur'an)
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ عَلِّمْهُ الْكِتَابَ ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: At what age may a youth be listened to (i.e. quotation of the Hadith from a boy be acceptable)
chapters.name_ar: مَتَى يَصِحُّ سَمَاعُ الصَّغِيرِ

chapters.name_en: To go out in search of knowledge
chapters.name_ar: الْخُرُوجِ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of a person who learns (Islam, becomes a religious scholar) and then teaches it to others
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ مَنْ عَلِمَ وَعَلَّمَ

chapters.name_en: (What is said regarding) the disappearance of the (religious) knowledge and the appearance of (religious) ignorance
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْعِلْمِ وَظُهُورِ الْجَهْلِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of (religious) knowledge
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: To give a religious verdict while riding an animal or standing on anything else
chapters.name_ar: الْفُتْيَا وَهُوَ وَاقِفٌ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ وَغَيْرِهَا

chapters.name_en: Whoever gave a religious verdict by beckoning or by nodding
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَجَابَ الْفُتْيَا بِإِشَارَةِ الْيَدِ وَالرَّأْسِ

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saws) urged the people (mission) of 'Abdul Qais to memorize the faith and the (religious) knowledge (as he explained to them) and to inform (convey) to their people whom they left behind (at home)
chapters.name_ar: تَحْرِيضِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَفْدَ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى أَنْ يَحْفَظُوا الإِيمَانَ وَالْعِلْمَ وَيُخْبِرُوا مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ

chapters.name_en: To travel seeking an answer to a problematic matter, and to teach it to one's family
chapters.name_ar: الرِّحْلَةِ فِي الْمَسْأَلَةِ النَّازِلَةِ وَتَعْلِيمِ أَهْلِهِ

chapters.name_en: To fix the duties in rotation for learning (religious) knowledge
chapters.name_ar: التَّنَاوُبِ فِي الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: To be furious while preaching or teaching if one sees what one hates
chapters.name_ar: الْغَضَبِ فِي الْمَوْعِظَةِ وَالتَّعْلِيمِ إِذَا رَأَى مَا يَكْرَهُ

chapters.name_en: Whoever knelt down before the Imam or a (religious) preacher
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ بَرَكَ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ عِنْدَ الإِمَامِ أَوِ الْمُحَدِّثِ

chapters.name_en: Repeating ones talk thrice in order to make others understand
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَعَادَ الْحَدِيثَ ثَلاَثًا لِيُفْهَمَ عَنْهُ

chapters.name_en: A man teaching (religion to) his woman-slave and his family
chapters.name_ar: تَعْلِيمِ الرَّجُلِ أَمَتَهُ وَأَهْلَهُ

chapters.name_en: The preaching (and teaching) of the (religious) knowledge to women by the Imam (Chief)
chapters.name_ar: عِظَةِ الإِمَامِ النِّسَاءَ وَتَعْلِيمِهِنَّ

chapters.name_en: Eagerness to (learn) the Hadith
chapters.name_ar: الْحِرْصِ عَلَى الْحَدِيثِ

chapters.name_en: How the (religious) knowledge will be taken away
chapters.name_ar: كَيْفَ يُقْبَضُ الْعِلْمُ

chapters.name_en: Should a day be fixed for women in order to teach them religion (apart from men)?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يُجْعَلُ لِلنِّسَاءِ يَوْمٌ عَلَى حِدَةٍ فِي الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever heard something (but did not understand it) and then asked again till he understood it completely
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ سَمِعَ شَيْئًا، فَرَاجَعَ حَتَّى يَعْرِفَهُ

chapters.name_en: It is incumbent on those who are present [in a religious meeting (or conference)] to convey the knowledge to those who are absent
chapters.name_ar: لِيُبَلِّغِ الْعِلْمَ الشَّاهِدُ الْغَائِبَ

chapters.name_en: The sin of a person who tells a lie against the Prophet (saws)
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ مَنْ كَذَبَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم

chapters.name_en: The writing of knowledge
chapters.name_ar: كِتَابَةِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: The knowledge and its teaching and preaching at night
chapters.name_ar: الْعِلْمِ وَالْعِظَةِ بِاللَّيْلِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said regarding) the memorization of (religious) knowledge
chapters.name_ar: حِفْظِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: To be quiet (and listen) to religious learned men
chapters.name_ar: الإِنْصَاتِ لِلْعُلَمَاءِ

chapters.name_en: When a religious learned man is asked, "Who is the most learned person." it is better for him to attribute or entrust absolute knowledge to Allah 'Azza wa Jall and to say. "Allah is the Most Learned (than anybody else)"
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْعَالِمِ إِذَا سُئِلَ أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَعْلَمُ فَيَكِلُ الْعِلْمَ إِلَى اللَّهِ

chapters.name_en: Whosoever, while standing, asked a religious learned man who was sitting (on a pulpit or a similar thing, about something)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ سَأَلَ وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ عَالِمًا جَالِسًا

chapters.name_en: To ask about a religious matter and to give a religious verdict (at Mina during Hajj) while doing the Rami of Jimar (throwing of pebbles at the Jimar in Mina during Hajj)
chapters.name_ar: السُّؤَالِ وَالْفُتْيَا عِنْدَ رَمْىِ الْجِمَارِ

chapters.name_en: The Statement of Allah Ta'ala: "And of knowledge you (mankind) have been given only a little"
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً}

chapters.name_en: Whosoever left some optional things simply for the fear that some people may not be able to understand them and may fall into something more difficult
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ تَرَكَ بَعْضَ الاِخْتِيَارِ مَخَافَةَ أَنْ يَقْصُرَ فَهْمُ بَعْضِ النَّاسِ عَنْهُ فَيَقَعُوا فِي أَشَدَّ مِنْهُ

chapters.name_en: Whoever selected some people to teach them (religious) knowledge preferring them over others for fear that the others may not understand it
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ خَصَّ بِالْعِلْمِ قَوْمًا دُونَ قَوْمٍ كَرَاهِيَةَ أَنْ لاَ يَفْهَمُوا

chapters.name_en: (What is said as regards): To be shy (Al-Haya) while learning (religious) knowledge
chapters.name_ar: الْحَيَاءِ فِي الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: Whosoever felt shy (to ask something) and then requested another person to ask on his behalf
chapters.name_ar: مَنِ اسْتَحْيَا فَأَمَرَ غَيْرَهُ بِالسُّؤَالِ

chapters.name_en: Teaching religious knowledge and giving religious verdicts in a masjid
chapters.name_ar: ذِكْرِ الْعِلْمِ وَالْفُتْيَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Whosoever answered the questioner more than what was asked
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَجَابَ السَّائِلَ بِأَكْثَرَ مِمَّا سَأَلَهُ

chapters.name_en: Chapter. No Salat (prayer) Is Accepted Without Ablution (i.e, To Remove, The  Small Hadith By Ablution Or The Big Hadith By Taking A Bath)
chapters.name_ar: لاَ تُقْبَلُ صَلاَةٌ بِغَيْرِ طُهُورٍ

chapters.name_en: Chapter. The Superiority Of Ablution. And Al-ghurr-ul-muhajjalun (the Parts Of The Body Of The Muslims Washed In Ablution Will Shine On The Day Of Ressurrection And The Angels Will Call Them By That Name) From The Traces Of Ablution
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ الْوُضُوءِ، وَالْغُرُّ الْمُحَجَّلُونَ مِنْ آثَارِ الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: One should not repeat ablution if in doubt unless and until he is convinced (that he has lost his ablution by having Hadath)
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَتَوَضَّأُ مِنَ الشَّكِّ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِنَ

chapters.name_en: To perform a light ablution
chapters.name_ar: التَّخْفِيفِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: The completion (or perfection) of ablution (one should wash all the parts perfectly)
chapters.name_ar: إِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: To wash the face with both hands by a handful of water
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الْوَجْهِ بِالْيَدَيْنِ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ

chapters.name_en: To recite "In the name of Allah," during every action and on having sexual relations with one's wife
chapters.name_ar: التَّسْمِيَةِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ وَعِنْدَ الْوِقَاعِ

chapters.name_en: What to say while going to the lavatory (water closet)
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْخَلاَءِ

chapters.name_en: Providing water at lavatories (for washing the private parts after answering the call of nature)
chapters.name_ar: وَضْعِ الْمَاءِ عِنْدَ الْخَلاَءِ

chapters.name_en: While urinating or defecating, never face the Qiblah except when you are screened by a building or a wall or something like that
chapters.name_ar: لاَ تُسْتَقْبَلُ الْقِبْلَةُ بِغَائِطٍ أَوْ بَوْلٍ إِلاَّ عِنْدَ الْبِنَاءِ جِدَارٍ أَوْ نَحْوِهِ

chapters.name_en: Defecating while sitting over two bricks
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ تَبَرَّزَ عَلَى لَبِنَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The going out of women for answering the call of nature
chapters.name_ar: خُرُوجِ النِّسَاءِ إِلَى الْبَرَازِ

chapters.name_en: To defecate in houses
chapters.name_ar: التَّبَرُّزِ فِي الْبُيُوتِ

chapters.name_en: To wash the private parts with water after answering the call of nature
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ بِالْمَاءِ

chapters.name_en: Getting water carried by somebody else for purification (washing one's private parts).
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ حُمِلَ مَعَهُ الْمَاءُ لِطُهُورِهِ

chapters.name_en: To carry an 'Anaza (spear-headed stick) along with the water for washing the private parts after answering the call of nature.
chapters.name_ar: حَمْلِ الْعَنَزَةِ مَعَ الْمَاءِ فِي الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ

chapters.name_en: It is forbidden to clean the private parts with the right hand
chapters.name_ar: النَّهْىِ عَنْ الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ، بِالْيَمِينِ

chapters.name_en: While passing urine one should not hold his penis with his right hand.
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يُمْسِكُ ذَكَرَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ إِذَا بَالَ

chapters.name_en: To clean the private parts with stones
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ بِالْحِجَارَةِ

chapters.name_en: Do not clean the private parts with dung
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يُسْتَنْجَى بِرَوْثٍ

chapters.name_en: The washing of the body parts (i.e., the parts which are washed in ablution) once only while performing ablution
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً

chapters.name_en: The washing of the body parts twice while performing ablution
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The washing of the parts thrice while performing ablution
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ ثَلاَثًا ثَلاَثًا

chapters.name_en: The cleaning of the nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out during ablution
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِنْثَارِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: To clean the private parts with odd number of stones
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِجْمَارِ وِتْرًا

chapters.name_en: Washing both feet, and it is not sufficient to pass wet hands over the feet
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ وَلاَ يَمْسَحُ عَلَى الْقَدَمَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: To rinse the mouth with water while performing ablution
chapters.name_ar: الْمَضْمَضَةِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: The washing of heels during ablution
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الأَعْقَابِ

chapters.name_en: Washing the feet when one is wearing the shoes, and it is not sufficient for one to pass a wet hand over the shoes (but one should take off the shoes and wash one's feet)
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ فِي النَّعْلَيْنِ وَلاَ يَمْسَحُ عَلَى النَّعْلَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: While performing ablution or taking a bath one should start from the right side of the body
chapters.name_ar: التَّيَمُّنِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ وَالْغُسْلِ

chapters.name_en: To look for water (for ablution) when the time for the prayer is due
chapters.name_ar: الْتِمَاسِ الْوَضُوءِ إِذَا حَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ

chapters.name_en: What is said regarding the water with which human hair has been washed
chapters.name_ar: الْمَاءِ الَّذِي يُغْسَلُ بِهِ شَعَرُ الإِنْسَانِ

chapters.name_en: If a dog drinks from the utensil of any one of you then it is essential to wash it seven times
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا شَرِبَ الْكَلْبُ فِي إِنَاءِ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَغْسِلْهُ سَبْعًا

chapters.name_en: Whosoever considers not to repeat ablution except if something is discharged or passed from exit (front or back private parts)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ الْوُضُوءَ إِلاَّ مِنَ الْمَخْرَجَيْنِ، مِنَ الْقُبُلِ وَالدُّبُرِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said regarding) a man who helps his companion to perform ablution (by pouring water for him)
chapters.name_ar: الرَّجُلِ يُوَضِّئُ صَاحِبَهُ

chapters.name_en: The recitation of Quran or doing other invocations etc. after Hadath
chapters.name_ar: قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ بَعْدَ الْحَدَثِ وَغَيْرِهِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever does not repeat ablution except after fallinginto deep sleep - losing consciousness completely
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ إِلاَّ مِنَ الْغَشْىِ الْمُثْقِلِ

chapters.name_en: To pass wet hands over the whole head during ablution
chapters.name_ar: مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ كُلِّهِ

chapters.name_en: The washing of feet unto the ankles
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ إِلَى الْكَعْبَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The using of the remaining water after ablution
chapters.name_ar: اسْتِعْمَالِ فَضْلِ وَضُوءِ النَّاسِ

chapters.name_en: Rinsing one's mouth and putting water in one's nose and cleaning it by blowing the water out with a single handful of water
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ مَضْمَضَ وَاسْتَنْشَقَ مِنْ غَرْفَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ

chapters.name_en: The passing of wet hands over the head once only (while performing ablution)
chapters.name_ar: مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ مَرَّةً

chapters.name_en: The performance of ablution by a man along with his wife. The utilization of water remaining after a woman has performed ablution. Umar performed ablution with warm water and with water brought from the house of a Christian woman
chapters.name_ar: وُضُوءِ الرَّجُلِ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ وَفَضْلِ وَضُوءِ الْمَرْأَةِ‏

chapters.name_en: The sprinkling of remaining water after performing ablution on an unconscious person by the prophet (saw)
chapters.name_ar: صَبِّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَضُوءَهُ عَلَى الْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ

chapters.name_en: To take a bath or perform ablution from a Mikhdab (utensil), a tumbler, or a wooden or stone pot
chapters.name_ar: الْغُسْلِ وَالْوُضُوءِ فِي الْمِخْضَبِ وَالْقَدَحِ وَالْخَشَبِ وَالْحِجَارَةِ

chapters.name_en: To perform ablution from an earthen-ware pot
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ التَّوْرِ

chapters.name_en: To perform ablution with one Mudd of water. (Mudd is practically 2/3 of the kilogram)
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ بِالْمُدِّ

chapters.name_en: To pass wet hands over Khuffain [two leather socks covering the ankles]
chapters.name_ar: الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ

chapters.name_en: If one puts on (Khuff) just after performing ablution (ther is no need to wash one's feet again in ablution) (24 hours for non-travellers and three days for travelers)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا أَدْخَلَ رِجْلَيْهِ وَهُمَا طَاهِرَتَانِ

chapters.name_en: Not repeating ablution after eating mutton and As-Sawiq
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ مِنْ لَحْمِ الشَّاةِ وَالسَّوِيقِ

chapters.name_en: Rinsing one's mouth (with water) after eating As-Sawiq without repaying ablution
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ مَضْمَضَ مِنَ السَّوِيقِ وَلَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ

chapters.name_en: Whether to rinse the mouth after drinking milk
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يُمَضْمِضُ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ

chapters.name_en: Ablution after sleep. And whoever considers it unnecessary to repeat ablution after dozing once or twice or after nodding once in slumber
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ النَّوْمِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَرَ مِنَ النَّعْسَةِ وَالنَّعْسَتَيْنِ أَوِ الْخَفْقَةِ وُضُوءًا

chapters.name_en: To perform ablution even on having no Hadath
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَدَثٍ

chapters.name_en: One of the major sins is not to protect oneself (one's clothes and body) from one's urine (i.e., from being soiled with it)
chapters.name_ar: مِنَ الْكَبَائِرِ أَنْ لاَ يَسْتَتِرَ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ

chapters.name_en: What is said regarding washing out urine
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي غَسْلِ الْبَوْلِ
باب ما جاء في غسل البول

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saw) and the people left the bedouin undisturbed till he finished urinating in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: تَرْكِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَالنَّاسِ الأَعْرَابِيَّ حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The pouring of water over the urine in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: صَبِّ الْمَاءِ عَلَى الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The urine of children
chapters.name_ar: بَوْلِ الصِّبْيَانِ

chapters.name_en: To pass urine while standing and sitting
chapters.name_ar: الْبَوْلِ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا

chapters.name_en: To urinate beside one's companion while screened by a wall
chapters.name_ar: الْبَوْلِ عِنْدَ صَاحِبِهِ وَالتَّسَتُّرِ بِالْحَائِطِ

chapters.name_en: To urinate near the dumps of some people
chapters.name_ar: الْبَوْلِ عِنْدَ سُبَاطَةِ قَوْمٍ

chapters.name_en: The washing out of blood
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الدَّمِ

chapters.name_en: The washing out of semen with water and rubbing it off (when it is dry) and the washing out of what comes out of women (i.e., discharge)
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الْمَنِيِّ وَفَرْكِهِ وَغَسْلِ مَا يُصِيبُ مِنَ الْمَرْأَةِ

chapters.name_en: If the (traces of) Janaba (semen) or other spots are not removed completely on washing
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا غَسَلَ الْجَنَابَةَ أَوْ غَيْرَهَا فَلَمْ يَذْهَبْ أَثَرُهُ

chapters.name_en: (What is said) about the urine of camels, sheep and other animals and about their folds
chapters.name_ar: أَبْوَالِ الإِبِلِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالْغَنَمِ وَمَرَابِضِهَا

chapters.name_en: An-Najasat (impure and filthy things) which fall in cooking butter (ghee - which is obtained by evaporating moisture from butter) and water
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَقَعُ مِنَ النَّجَاسَاتِ فِي السَّمْنِ وَالْمَاءِ

chapters.name_en: Urinating in stagnant water
chapters.name_ar: الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الدَّائِمِ

chapters.name_en: If a dead body or a polluted thing is put on the back of a person offering Salat (prayer), his Salat will not be annulled (rejected by Allah)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا أُلْقِيَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الْمُصَلِّي قَذَرٌ أَوْ جِيفَةٌ لَمْ تَفْسُدْ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَتُهُ

chapters.name_en: Spitting or blowing out the nose or doing similar action in one's own garment
chapters.name_ar: الْبُزَاقِ وَالْمُخَاطِ وَنَحْوِهِ فِي الثَّوْبِ

chapters.name_en: It is unlawful to perform ablution with Nabidh (water in which dates or grapes etc, are soaked and is not yet fermented) or with any other intoxicant
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَجُوزُ الْوُضُوءُ بِالنَّبِيذِ وَلاَ الْمُسْكِرِ

chapters.name_en: Washing blood by a women off her father's face
chapters.name_ar: غَسْلِ الْمَرْأَةِ أَبَاهَا الدَّمَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ

chapters.name_en: Siwak (to clean the teeth with Siwak which is a tooth-brush in the form of a pencil from the roots of the Arak tree
chapters.name_ar: السِّوَاكِ

chapters.name_en: To give Siwak to the oldest person of the group
chapters.name_ar: دَفْعِ السِّوَاكِ إِلَى الأَكْبَرِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of a person who sleeps with ablution.
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ مَنْ بَاتَ عَلَى الْوُضُوءِ

chapters.name_en: The performance of ablution before taking a bath
chapters.name_ar: الْوُضُوءِ قَبْلَ الْغُسْلِ

chapters.name_en: Taking a bath by a man along with his wife
chapters.name_ar: غُسْلِ الرَّجُلِ مَعَ امْرَأَتِهِ

chapters.name_en: Taking a bath with a Sa' of water or so (One Sa' = 3 kilograms approx.)
chapters.name_ar: الْغُسْلِ بِالصَّاعِ وَنَحْوِهِ

chapters.name_en: Pouring water thrice on one's head
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَفَاضَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ثَلاَثًا

chapters.name_en: To wash the body (parts) once only
chapters.name_ar: الْغُسْلِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً

chapters.name_en: Starting one's bath by scenting oneself with Hilab or some other scent
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْحِلاَبِ أَوِ الطِّيبِ عِنْدَ الْغُسْلِ

chapters.name_en: To rinse the mouth and to clean the nose by putting water in it and then blowing it out while taking the bath of Janaba
chapters.name_ar: الْمَضْمَضَةِ وَالاِسْتِنْشَاقِ فِي الْجَنَابَةِ

chapters.name_en: The rubbing of hands with earth in ore to clean them thoroughly

chapters.name_en: Interval during ablution or bath

chapters.name_en: Whoever performed the ablution of Janaba and then washed his body but did not wash once again the parts which were washed in ablution

chapters.name_en: If someone while in the mosque remembers that he is Junub, he should leave (the mosque to take a bath) and should not perform Tayammum

chapters.name_en: The removing of water from one's body with one's hands after taking the bath of Janaba

chapters.name_en: Whosoever took a bath alone (in seclusion) completely naked
chapters.name_ar: مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ عُرْيَانًا وَحْدَهُ فِي الْخَلْوَةِ، وَمَنْ تَسَتَّرَ فَالتَّسَتُّرُ أَفْضَلُ

chapters.name_en: A Junub can stay at home without taking a bath but with ablution

chapters.name_en: What to do if neither water nor earth is available

chapters.name_en: The performance of Tayammum by a non-traveller (is permissible) when water is not available and when one is afraid that the time of Salat (prayer) may elapse

chapters.name_en: Can a person blow off the dust from his hands in performing Tayammum (before passing them over his face)

chapters.name_en: Clean earth is sufficient for a Muslim as a substitute for water for ablution (if he does not find water)

chapters.name_en: A Junub can perform Tayammum if he is afraid of disease, death or thirst

chapters.name_en: To tie Izar (dress worn below the waist) at one's back while offering Salat (prayers)

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayers) with a single garment wrapped round the body
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ مُلْتَحِفًا بِهِ

chapters.name_en: If someone offers Salat (prayer) wrapped in a single garment, he should cross its corners round his shoulders

chapters.name_en: If the garment is tight (over the body)

chapters.name_en: It is disliked to the naked during As-Salat (the prayers)

chapters.name_en: Whoever offered Salat (prayer)in a silk Farruj (an outer garment opened at the back) and then took it off.
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى فِي فَرُّوجِ حَرِيرٍ ثُمَّ نَزَعَهُ

chapters.name_en: (It is permissible) to offer Salat (prayer) in a red garment

chapters.name_ar: قِبْلَةِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَأَهْلِ الشَّأْمِ وَالْمَشْرِقِ

chapters.name_en: The Statement of Allah " And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim (Abraham) (or the stone on which Abrahim stood while he was building the Kabah as a place of prayer (for some of your Salat e.g., two Raka after the Tawaf of Kabah)"
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى}

chapters.name_en: The Statement of Allah " And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim (Abraham) (or the stone on which Abrahim stood while he was building the Kabah as a place of prayer (for some of your Salat e.g., two Raka after the Tawaf of Kabah)"
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى}

chapters.name_en: [During the obligatory Salat (prayers)] one should face the Qiblah (Kabah at Makkah) wherever one may be
chapters.name_ar: التَّوَجُّهِ نَحْوَ الْقِبْلَةِ حَيْثُ كَانَ

chapters.name_en: What has been said about (facing) the Qiblah (Kabah at Makkah) and wherever considered that there was no need to repeat the Salat (prayer) if someone offered prayers by mistake facing a direction other than that of the Qiblah
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ، وَمَنْ لاَ يَرَى الإِعَادَةَ عَلَى مَنْ سَهَا فَصَلَّى إِلَى غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ

chapters.name_en: To scrape off the sputum from the mosque with the hand (using some tool or other, or using  n tool)
chapters.name_ar: حَكِّ الْبُزَاقِ بِالْيَدِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To scrape the nasal secretion off the mosque with gravel
chapters.name_ar: حَكِّ الْمُخَاطِ بِالْحَصَى مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To scrape the nasal secretion off the mosque with gravel
chapters.name_ar: حَكِّ الْمُخَاطِ بِالْحَصَى مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: It is forbidden to spit on the right side while in Salat (prayers)
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: It is forbidden to spit on the right side while in Salat (prayers)
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَبْصُقْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ، فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: One should spit on the left side or under one's left foot
chapters.name_ar: لِيَبْزُقْ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ، أَوْ تَحْتَ قَدَمِهِ الْيُسْرَى

chapters.name_en: The expiation for spitting in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: كَفَّارَةِ الْبُزَاقِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The burying of the expectoration in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: دَفْنِ النُّخَامَةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: If the spit or sputum comes out suddenly then one should spit in the corner of one's garnet
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا بَدَرَهُ الْبُزَاقُ فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِطَرَفِ ثَوْبِهِ

chapters.name_en: Preaching of the Imam to the people regarding the proper offering of As-Salat (the prayers) and the mention of the Qiblah (Kabah at Makkah)
chapters.name_ar: عِظَةِ الإِمَامِ النَّاسَ فِي إِتْمَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَذِكْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to say, "Masjid (mosque) of Bani so-and-so?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يُقَالُ مَسْجِدُ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ

chapters.name_en: The distribution (of goods or wealh) and the hanging of a cluster of dates in the mosque.
chapters.name_ar: الْقِسْمَةِ وَتَعْلِيقِ الْقِنْوِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Receivng and invitation to dinner in the mosque and accepting it
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ دَعَا لِطَعَامٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَنْ أَجَابَ فِيهِ

chapters.name_en: To give the judicial verdicts in the mosque and to perform the Al-Lian between men and women (husbands and wives) there
chapters.name_ar: الْقَضَاءِ وَاللِّعَانِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ بَيْنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ

chapters.name_en: If someone enters a house, should he offer prayers where he likes, or as he is told? And he should not look out to seek information about the place or do spying
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ بَيْتًا يُصَلِّي حَيْثُ شَاءَ، أَوْ حَيْثُ أُمِرَ، وَلاَ يَتَجَسَّسُ

chapters.name_en: About (taking) the mosques in the houses
chapters.name_ar: الْمَسَاجِدِ فِي الْبُيُوتِ

chapters.name_en: While entering the mosques etc. one should start with the right foot
chapters.name_ar: التَّيَمُّنِ فِي دُخُولِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَغَيْرِهِ

chapters.name_en: Is it permissible to dig the graves of pagans of the period of Ignorance, and to use that place as a mosque?
chapters.name_ar: بَابُ هَلْ تُنْبَشُ قُبُورُ مُشْرِكِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ، وَيُتَّخَذُ مَكَانَهَا مَسَاجِدَ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) in a sheep-fold
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَرَابِضِ الْغَنَمِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) in the camel yards (the places where the camels are stationed)
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَوَاضِعِ الإِبِلِ

chapters.name_en: whoever offered Salat (prayer)  with furnace or fire or any other worshipable thing in front of him but he intended Salat solely for Allah
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى وَقُدَّامَهُ تَنُّورٌ أَوْ نَارٌ أَوْ شَىْءٌ مِمَّا يُعْبَدُ، فَأَرَادَ بِهِ اللَّهَ

chapters.name_en: The dislikeness of offering As-Salat (the prayers) in grave-yards
chapters.name_ar: كَرَاهِيَةِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي الْمَقَابِرِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said about) offering Salat (Prayer) at the places where the earth had sunk down and Allah's punishment had fallen
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَوَاضِعِ الْخَسْفِ وَالْعَذَابِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) in a church or in a temple etc.
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي الْبِيعَةِ
باب الصلاة في البيعة
باب الصلاة في البيعة

chapters.name_en: The sayings of the Prophet (pbuh) "The earth has been made for me a Masjid (place for praying) and a thing to purify (to perform Tayammum)."
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ جُعِلَتْ لِيَ الأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: Sleeping of a woman in the mosque (and residing in it)
chapters.name_ar: نَوْمِ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Sleeping of a men in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: نَوْمِ الرِّجَالِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) whe returning from a journey
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ

chapters.name_en: If one entered a mosque, one should offer two Rak'a (Tahayyat-al-Masjid) before sitting
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: Al-Hadath (passing wind) in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الْحَدَثِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The construction of (the prophet's pbuh) mosque
chapters.name_ar: بُنْيَانِ الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To co-operate in building a mosque
chapters.name_ar: التَّعَاوُنِ فِي بِنَاءِ الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Employing the carpenter and the technical hand (artsan) in making the wooden pulpit or building the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِعَانَةِ بِالنَّجَّارِ وَالصُّنَّاعِ فِي أَعْوَادِ الْمِنْبَرِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: (The superiority of) whoever built a mosque
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا

chapters.name_en: While passing through a mosque, (one should better) hold the arrowheads (with the hand)
chapters.name_ar: يَأْخُذُ بِنُصُولِ النَّبْلِ إِذَا مَرَّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Passing through the mosque (is permissible)
chapters.name_ar: الْمُرُورِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: (What is said about) reciting poetry in the mosque?
chapters.name_ar: الشِّعْرِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The presence of spearmen (with their spears) in the mosque (is permissible)
chapters.name_ar: أَصْحَابِ الْحِرَابِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The presence of spearmen (with their spears) in the mosque (is permissible)
chapters.name_ar: أَصْحَابِ الْحِرَابِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Mentioning about sales and purchases on the pulpit in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: ذِكْرِ الْبَيْعِ وَالشِّرَاءِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Asking a debtor to repay what he owes and catching the debtor in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: التَّقَاضِي وَالْمُلاَزَمَةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Sweeping (cleaning) of the mosque and removing rags, dirt and sticks from it
chapters.name_ar: كَنْسِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَالْتِقَاطِ الْخِرَقِ وَالْقَذَى وَالْعِيدَانِ

chapters.name_en: The order of banning the trade of alcoholic drinks was issues in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: تَحْرِيمِ تِجَارَةِ الْخَمْرِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: Servants for the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الْخَدَمِ لِلْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To fasten a prisoner or a debtor in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الأَسِيرِ أَوِ الْغَرِيمِ يُرْبَطُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To take a bath on embracing Islam and fasten a prisoner in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الاِغْتِسَالِ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ، وَرَبْطِ الأَسِيرِ أَيْضًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To pitch a tent in the mosque for patients, etc
chapters.name_ar: الْخَيْمَةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِلْمَرْضَى وَغَيْرِهِمْ

chapters.name_en: To take the camel inside the mosque if necessary
chapters.name_ar: إِدْخَالِ الْبَعِيرِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِلْعِلَّةِ
باب

chapters.name_en: Al-Khaukhah (a small door) and a path in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الْخَوْخَةِ وَالْمَمَرِّ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The doors and locks of the Kabah and the mosques
chapters.name_ar: الأَبْوَابِ وَالْغَلَقِ لِلْكَعْبَةِ وَالْمَسَاجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The entering of a pagan in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: دُخُولِ الْمُشْرِكِ الْمَسْجِدَ

chapters.name_en: Raising the voice in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الصَّوْتِ فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The religious gathering in circles and sitting in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الْحِلَقِ وَالْجُلُوسِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

chapters.name_en: To lie flat (on the back) in the mosque
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِلْقَاءِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَدِّ الرِّجْلِ

chapters.name_en: (If) a mosque (is built) on a road, it should not be a cause of harm for the people
chapters.name_ar: الْمَسْجِدِ يَكُونُ فِي الطَّرِيقِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَرَرٍ بِالنَّاسِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayers) in a mosque situated in a market
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ السُّوقِ

chapters.name_en: To clasp one's hands by interlocking the fingers in the mosque or outside the mosque
chapters.name_ar: تَشْبِيكِ الأَصَابِعِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَغَيْرِهِ

chapters.name_en: To clasp one's hands by interlocking the fingers in the mosque or outside the mosque
chapters.name_ar: تَشْبِيكِ الأَصَابِعِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَغَيْرِهِ

chapters.name_en: The mosques which are on the way to Al-Madina and the places where the Prophet (pbuh) had offered Salat (Prayers)
chapters.name_ar: الْمَسَاجِدِ الَّتِي عَلَى طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ

chapters.name_en: The Sutra of the Imam is also a Sutra for those who are behind him
chapters.name_ar: سُتْرَةُ الإِمَامِ سُتْرَةُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ

chapters.name_en: What should be the distance between the person offering Salat (prayer) and the Sutra?
chapters.name_ar: قَدْرِ كَمْ يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَكُونَ بَيْنَ الْمُصَلِّي وَالسُّتْرَةِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) using a Harba (a short spear) (as a Sutra)
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى الْحَرْبَةِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) using an 'Anaza (a spear-headed stick) (as a Sutra)
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى الْعَنَزَةِ

chapters.name_en: Sutra (for the prayer)in Makkah and elsewhere.
chapters.name_ar: السُّتْرَةِ بِمَكَّةَ وَغَيْرِهَا

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) facing a pillar
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى الأُسْطُوَانَةِ

chapters.name_en: To offer non-congregational As-Salat (the prayers) between the pillars
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ بَيْنَ السَّوَارِي فِي غَيْرِ جَمَاعَةٍ
باب الصلاة بين السواري في غير جماعة

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) facing a Rahila camel, a tree or a camel saddle as a Sutra).
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ وَالْبَعِيرِ وَالشَّجَرِ وَالرَّحْلِ

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) facing a bed
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى السَّرِيرِ

chapters.name_en: The person offering Salat (prayer) should repulse that person who tries to pass in front of him
chapters.name_ar: يَرُدُّ الْمُصَلِّي مَنْ مَرَّ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ

chapters.name_en: The sin of a person who passes in front of a person offering Salat
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ الْمَارِّ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ الْمُصَلِّي

chapters.name_en: A man facing a man while offering Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: اسْتِقْبَالِ الرَّجُلِ صَاحِبَهُ أَوْ غَيْرَهُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي

chapters.name_en: To offer As-Salat (the prayer) behind a sleeping person
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ خَلْفَ النَّائِمِ

chapters.name_en: To offer Nawafil (non-obligatory prayers) behind a sleeping woman
chapters.name_ar: التَّطَوُّعِ خَلْفَ الْمَرْأَةِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever says "Nothing annuls As-Salat (the prayer) (i.e. nothing of what others do, not the praying person himself)."
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ قَالَ لاَ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاَةَ شَىْءٌ

chapters.name_en: If a small girl is carried on one's neck during the Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا حَمَلَ جَارِيَةً صَغِيرَةً عَلَى عُنُقِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: To offer Salat (prayer) facing a bed occupied by a menstruatng woman
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا صَلَّى إِلَى فِرَاشٍ فِيهِ حَائِضٌ

chapters.name_en: Is it permissible to touch or push one's wife in prostration in order to prostrate properly?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يَغْمِزُ الرَّجُلُ امْرَأَتَهُ عِنْدَ السُّجُودِ لِكَىْ يَسْجُدَ

chapters.name_en: A woman can remove troublesome or offensive things from a person in Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: الْمَرْأَةِ تَطْرَحُ عَنِ الْمُصَلِّي، شَيْئًا مِنَ الأَذَى

chapters.name_en: The times of As-Salat (the prayers) and the superiority of offering Salat (prayers) in time
chapters.name_ar: مَوَاقِيتِ الصَّلاَةِ وَفَضْلِهَا

chapters.name_en: The times of As-Salat (the prayers) and the superiority of offering Salat (prayers) in time
chapters.name_ar: مَوَاقِيتِ الصَّلاَةِ وَفَضْلِهَا

chapters.name_en: The Statement of Alah
chapters.name_ar: {مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَلاَ تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ}

chapters.name_en: To give the Bai'ah (pledge) for Iqamat-as-Salat [the offering of As-Salat (the prayers).
chapters.name_ar: الْبَيْعَةِ عَلَى إِقَامَةِ الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: As-Salat (the prayers) is expiation (of sins)
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةُ كَفَّارَةٌ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of offering As-Salat (the prayers) at the stated times
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ لِوَقْتِهَا

chapters.name_en: The five Salat (prayers) are expiations (of sins)
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ كَفَّارَةٌ

chapters.name_en: Not offering As-Salat (the prayers) at its stated fixed time
chapters.name_ar: تَضْيِيعِ الصَّلاَةِ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا

chapters.name_en: A person in Salat (prayer) is speaking in private to his Lord (Allah)
chapters.name_ar: الْمُصَلِّي يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ

chapters.name_en: In severe heat, offer Zuhr prayers when it becomes (a bit) cooler
chapters.name_ar: الإِبْرَادِ بِالظُّهْرِ فِي شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ

chapters.name_en: In severe heat, offer Zuhr prayers when it becomes (a bit) cooler
chapters.name_ar: الإِبْرَادِ بِالظُّهْرِ فِي شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ

chapters.name_en: When going on a journey, pray Zuhr prayer when it becomes cooler
chapters.name_ar: الإِبْرَادِ بِالظُّهْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ

chapters.name_en: The time of Zuhr prayer is when the sun declines (just after mid-day)
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ عِنْدَ الزَّوَالِ

chapters.name_en: To deny the Zuhr (prayer) up to the 'Asr (prayer) time
chapters.name_ar: تَأْخِيرِ الظُّهْرِ إِلَى الْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: The time of the Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: The sin of one who misses the 'Asr prayer (intentionally)
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ الْعَصْرُ

chapters.name_en: One who omits (does not offer) the 'Asr prayer (intentionally)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ تَرَكَ الْعَصْرَ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the 'Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever got (or was able to offer) only one Rak'a of the 'Asr prayer before sunset
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الْعَصْرِ قَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ

chapters.name_en: The time of the Maghrib prayer (evening prayer)
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever disliked to call the Maghrib prayer as the 'Isha' prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يُقَالَ لِلْمَغْرِبِ الْعِشَاءُ

chapters.name_en: The mention of 'Isha' and 'Atama and whoever took the two names as one and the same
chapters.name_ar: ذِكْرِ الْعِشَاءِ وَالْعَتَمَةِ وَمَنْ رَآهُ وَاسِعًا

chapters.name_en: The time of the Isha prayer. If the people get together (pray earlier), and if they come late (delay it)
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ النَّاسُ أَوْ تَأَخَّرُوا

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the 'Isha prayer
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: What is disliked about sleeping before the 'Isha prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: Sleeping before the 'Isha prayer if (one is) over-whelmed by it (sleep)
chapters.name_ar: النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ لِمَنْ غُلِبَ

chapters.name_en: Sleeping before the 'Isha prayer if (one is) over-whelmed by it (sleep)
chapters.name_ar: النَّوْمِ قَبْلَ الْعِشَاءِ لِمَنْ غُلِبَ

chapters.name_en: Time of the 'Isha prayer is up to the middle of the night
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ إِلَى نِصْفِ اللَّيْلِ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the Fajr (early morning) prayer
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: Time of the Fajr (early morning) prayer
chapters.name_ar: وَقْتِ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever got (or was able to offer) one Rak'a of the Fajr prayer (in time). [One Rak'a means, one standing, one bowing, and two prostrations].
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الْفَجْرِ رَكْعَةً

chapters.name_en: Whoever got (or was able to offer) one Rak'a of a prayer (in time)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً

chapters.name_en: What is said regarding the offering of As-Salat (the prayers) between the Fajr prayer and sunrise.
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ

chapters.name_en: What is said regarding the offering of As-Salat (the prayers) between the Fajr prayer and sunrise.
chapters.name_ar: الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ الشَّمْسُ

chapters.name_en: One should not try to offer As-Salat (the prayers) just before sunset
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَتَحَرَّى الصَّلاَةَ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever did not dislike to offer optional prayers except after the compulsory prayers of 'Asr and Fajr only
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَكْرَهِ الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَالْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: To offer the missed Salat (prayers) and the like after the 'Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُصَلَّى بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ مِنَ الْفَوَائِتِ وَنَحْوِهَا

chapters.name_en: To offer (the 'Asr prayers) earlier on a cloudy day
chapters.name_ar: التَّبْكِيرِ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِي يَوْمِ غَيْمٍ

chapters.name_en: The Adhan for the Salat (prayer) after its stated time is over
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانِ بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ الْوَقْتِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever led the people in Salat (prayer) after its time was over
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ جَمَاعَةً بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ الْوَقْتِ

chapters.name_en: One who forgets a Salat (prayer) should offer it when he remembers it, and should not repeat anything except that particular prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ نَسِيَ صَلاَةً فَلْيُصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا وَلاَ يُعِيدُ إِلاَّ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةَ

chapters.name_en: The Qada of prayers (Qada means to perform or offer or do a missed religious obligation after its stated time)
chapters.name_ar: قَضَاءِ الصَّلَوَاتِ الأُولَى فَالأُولَى

chapters.name_en: What is disliked about talking after the 'Isha prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ السَّمَرِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: Talking about the Islamic jurisprudence and good things after the 'Isha prayer
chapters.name_ar: السَّمَرِ فِي الْفِقْهِ وَالْخَيْرِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: To talk with the family and the guests after the 'sha prayer.
chapters.name_ar: السَّمَرِ مَعَ الضَّيْفِ وَالأَهْلِ

chapters.name_en: How the Adhan for Salat (Prayer) was started
chapters.name_ar: بَدْءُ الأَذَانِ

chapters.name_en: Pronouncing the wording of Adhan for Salat (prayers) twice (in doubles)
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانُ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى

chapters.name_en: To pronounce the wording of Iqama once (in singles) except Qad-qamat-is-Salat
chapters.name_ar: الإِقَامَةُ وَاحِدَةٌ، إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ التَّأْذِينِ

chapters.name_en: Raising the voice in pronouncing the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الصَّوْتِ بِالنِّدَاءِ

chapters.name_en: To suspend fighting on hearing the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُحْقَنُ بِالأَذَانِ مِنَ الدِّمَاءِ

chapters.name_en: What to say on hearing the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا سَمِعَ الْمُنَادِي

chapters.name_en: Invocation at the time of Adhan
chapters.name_ar: الدُّعَاءِ عِنْدَ النِّدَاءِ

chapters.name_en: To draw lots for pronouncing the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: الاِسْتِهَامِ فِي الأَذَانِ

chapters.name_en: Talking during the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: الْكَلاَمِ فِي الأَذَانِ

chapters.name_en: The Adhan pronounced by a blind man (is permissible) when there is a person to inform him about the time of the Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: أَذَانِ الأَعْمَى إِذَا كَانَ لَهُ مَنْ يُخْبِرُهُ

chapters.name_en: The Adhan after Al-Fajr (dawn)
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: The Adhan before Al-Fajr (dawn)
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: The Adhan before Al-Fajr (dawn)
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: How long should the interval between the Adhan and the Iqama be? (And something concerning) the person who wants for the Iqama
chapters.name_ar: كَمْ بَيْنَ الأَذَانِ وَالإِقَامَةِ وَمَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ الإِقَامَةَ

chapters.name_en: Whoever waits for the Iqama of the prayer
chapters.name_ar: مَنِ انْتَظَرَ الإِقَامَةَ

chapters.name_en: Between every two calls (Adhan and Iqama) there is a Salat (prayer) (that is optional) for the one who wants to offer it.
chapters.name_ar: بَيْنَ كُلِّ أَذَانَيْنِ صَلاَةٌ لِمَنْ شَاءَ

chapters.name_en: Whoever said that there should be one Mu'adh-dhin in the journey
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ قَالَ لِيُؤَذِّنْ فِي السَّفَرِ مُؤَذِّنٌ وَاحِدٌ

chapters.name_en: If there are many travellers, Adhan and Iqama should be pronounced, (the same is to be observed) in 'Arafat and Al-Muzdalifa too
chapters.name_ar: الأَذَانِ لِلْمُسَافِرِ إِذَا كَانُوا جَمَاعَةً، وَالإِقَامَةِ، وَكَذَلِكَ بِعَرَفَةَ وَجَمْعٍ

chapters.name_en: Should the Mu'adh-dhin turn his mouth (face) and look from side to side during the Adhan?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يَتَتَبَّعُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فَاهُ هَا هُنَا وَهَا هُنَا، وَهَلْ يَلْتَفِتُ فِي الأَذَانِ

chapters.name_en: The saying of a person "We have missed As-Salat (the prayer)"
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ فَاتَتْنَا الصَّلاَةُ

chapters.name_en: One should not run for As-Salat (the prayer) but present himself with calmness and solemnity
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَسْعَى إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ، وَلْيَأْتِ بِالسَّكِينَةِ وَالْوَقَارِ

chapters.name_en: When should the people get up for the Salat (prayer) if they see the Imam (the person leading Salat) during the Iqama?
chapters.name_ar: مَتَى يَقُومُ النَّاسُ إِذَا رَأَوُا الإِمَامَ عِنْدَ الإِقَامَةِ

chapters.name_en: One should not stand for As-Salat (the prayer) hurriedly but with calmness and solemnity.
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَسْعَى إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ مُسْتَعْجِلاً، وَلْيَقُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ وَالْوَقَارِ

chapters.name_en: Can one go out of the mosque (after the Adhan, or the Iqama) if there is a genuine excuse?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ لِعِلَّةٍ

chapters.name_en: If the Imam says, "Remain at your places till I return", then wait for him
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا قَالَ الإِمَامُ مَكَانَكُمْ. حَتَّى رَجَعَ انْتَظَرُوهُ

chapters.name_en: The saying of a man to the Prophet (pbuh), "We have not prayed."
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ مَا صَلَّيْنَا

chapters.name_en: If the Imam is confronted with a problem after the Iqama
chapters.name_ar: الإِمَامِ تَعْرِضُ لَهُ الْحَاجَةُ بَعْدَ الإِقَامَةِ

chapters.name_en: To talk after the Iqama
chapters.name_ar: الْكَلاَمِ إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ

chapters.name_en: Congregational Salat (prayer) is obligatory.
chapters.name_ar: وُجُوبِ صَلاَةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the congregational Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of the Fajr (early morning) prayer in congregation.
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of offering the Zuhr prayer early
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ التَّهْجِيرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of offering the Zuhr prayer early
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ التَّهْجِيرِ إِلَى الظُّهْرِ

chapters.name_en: Every step towards good deeds is rewarded
chapters.name_ar: احْتِسَابِ الآثَارِ

chapters.name_en: Every step towards good deeds is rewarded
chapters.name_ar: احْتِسَابِ الآثَارِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of the 'Isha' prayer in congregation
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ الْعِشَاءِ فِي الْجَمَاعَةِ

chapters.name_en: Two or more than two persons are considered as a group (for the congregational prayers)
chapters.name_ar: اثْنَانِ فَمَا فَوْقَهُمَا جَمَاعَةٌ

chapters.name_en: (The reward of a person) who waits for As-Salat (the prayer) in the mosque and the superiority of mosques
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ جَلَسَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَنْتَظِرُ الصَّلاَةَ، وَفَضْلِ الْمَسَاجِدِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of going to the mosque (every) morning and in the afternoon and evening [for the congregational Salat (prayers)]
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ مَنْ غَدَا إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَنْ رَاحَ

chapters.name_en: No Salat (prayer) (is to be offered) except the compulsory Salat after the Iqama has been pronounced for that compulsory Salat
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ

chapters.name_en: The limit set for a patient to attend the congregational Salat (prayer)?
chapters.name_ar: حَدِّ الْمَرِيضِ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ الْجَمَاعَةَ

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to pray at one's dwelling during rain or if there is a genuine excuse
chapters.name_ar: الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الْمَطَرِ وَالْعِلَّةِ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فِي رَحْلِهِ

chapters.name_en: Can the Imam offer the Salat (prayer) with only those who are present (for the prayer)? And can be deliver a Khutba (religious talk) on Friday if it is raining?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يُصَلِّي الإِمَامُ بِمَنْ حَضَرَ وَهَلْ يَخْطُبُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي الْمَطَرِ

chapters.name_en: (WHat should one do) if the meal has been served and the Iqama has been pronounced for As-Salat(the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا حَضَرَ الطَّعَامُ وَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ

chapters.name_en: When the Imam is called for As-Salat (the prayer) while he has in his hands something to eat.
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا دُعِيَ الإِمَامُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ وَبِيَدِهِ مَا يَأْكُلُ

chapters.name_en: If somebody was busy with his domestic work and Iqama was pronounced and then he came out [for offering the Salat (prayer)]
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَهْلِهِ فَأُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَخَرَجَ

chapters.name_en: Offering Salat (prayer) in front of the people with the sole intention of teaching them the Salat of the Prophet (pbuh) and his Sunnah (legal ways etc.)
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ وَهْوَ لاَ يُرِيدُ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُعَلِّمَهُمْ صَلاَةَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسُنَّتَهُ

chapters.name_en: The religious learned men are entitled to precedence in leading the Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: أَهْلُ الْعِلْمِ وَالْفَضْلِ أَحَقُّ بِالإِمَامَةِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever stood by the side of the Imam because of a genuine cause [in Salat (prayer)]
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ قَامَ إِلَى جَنْبِ الإِمَامِ لِعِلَّةٍ

chapters.name_en: If somebody is leading the Salat (prayer) and (in the meanwhile) the first (usual) Imam comes, the Salat is valid whether the former retreats or does not retreat
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ دَخَلَ لِيَؤُمَّ النَّاسَ فَجَاءَ الإِمَامُ الأَوَّلُ فَتَأَخَّرَ الأَوَّلُ أَوْ لَمْ يَتَأَخَّرْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ‏

chapters.name_en: If some people are equally proficient in the recitation of the Quran (and religious knowledge), the oldest of them should lead As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا اسْتَوَوْا فِي الْقِرَاءَةِ فَلْيَؤُمَّهُمْ أَكْبَرُهُمْ

chapters.name_en: If the Imam visited some people and led them in Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا زَارَ الإِمَامُ قَومًا فَأَمَّهُمْ

chapters.name_en: The Imam is appointed to be followed
chapters.name_ar: إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ

chapters.name_en: When should those who are behind the Imam prostrate?
chapters.name_ar: مَتَى يَسْجُدُ مَنْ خَلْفَ الإِمَامِ

chapters.name_en: The sin of the one who raises his head before the Imam (raises his head)
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ مَنْ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ قَبْلَ الإِمَامِ

chapters.name_en: A slave or a manumitted slave can lead the Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِمَامَةِ الْعَبْدِ وَالْمَوْلَى

chapters.name_en: If the Imam does not offer the Salat (prayer) perfectly and the followers offer it perfectly
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا لَمْ يُتِمَّ الإِمَامُ وَأَتَمَّ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ

chapters.name_en: Offering prayers behind a man who is a victim of Al-Fitan (trials and affections) or a heretic.
chapters.name_ar: إِمَامَةِ الْمَفْتُونِ وَالْمُبْتَدِعِ

chapters.name_en: To stand on the right side of the Imam on the same line if only two persons (counting the Imam) are offering Salat (prayer) in congregation
chapters.name_ar: يَقُومُ عَنْ يَمِينِ الإِمَامِ، بِحِذَائِهِ سَوَاءً إِذَا كَانَا اثْنَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: If a man stood on the left side of the Imam and the Imam drew him to his right side, then the Salat of none of them would be invalid
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا قَامَ الرَّجُلُ عَنْ يَسَارِ الإِمَامِ، فَحَوَّلَهُ الإِمَامُ إِلَى يَمِينِهِ لَمْ تَفْسُدْ صَلاَتُهُمَا

chapters.name_en: If the Imam has not had the intention of leading the prayer and then some persons join him and he leads them
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا لَمْ يَنْوِ الإِمَامُ أَنْ يَؤُمَّ ثُمَّ جَاءَ قَوْمٌ فَأَمَّهُمْ

chapters.name_en: If the Imam prolongs the Salat (prayer) and somebody has an urgent work or need and so he leaves the congregation and offers Salat alone.
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا طَوَّلَ الإِمَامُ وَكَانَ لِلرَّجُلِ حَاجَةٌ فَخَرَجَ فَصَلَّى

chapters.name_en: The shortening of the Qiyam (standing) by the Imam[in Salat (prayer)] but performing the bowings and the prostrations perfectly
chapters.name_ar: تَخْفِيفِ الإِمَامِ فِي الْقِيَامِ وَإِتْمَامِ الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: When offering Salat (prayer) alone, one can prolong the Salat as much as one wishes
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا صَلَّى لِنَفْسِهِ فَلْيُطَوِّلْ مَا شَاءَ

chapters.name_en: Complaining against one's Imam if he prolongs the prayer.
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ شَكَا إِمَامَهُ إِذَا طَوَّلَ

chapters.name_en: The shortening and perfection of the prayer (by the Imam)
chapters.name_ar: الإِيجَازِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَإِكْمَالِهَا

chapters.name_en: Whoever cuts short As-Salat (the prayer) on hearing the cries of a child.
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَخَفَّ الصَّلاَةَ عِنْدَ بُكَاءِ الصَّبِيِّ

chapters.name_en: If one offers Salat (prayer) and the leads the people in Salat.
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا صَلَّى ثُمَّ أَمَّ قَوْمًا

chapters.name_en: One who repeats the Takbir (Allahu Akbar) of the Imam so that the people may hear it.
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ أَسْمَعَ النَّاسَ تَكْبِيرَ الإِمَامِ

chapters.name_en: If a person follows the Imam and the others follow that person (then it is all right)
chapters.name_ar: الرَّجُلُ يَأْتَمُّ بِالإِمَامِ وَيَأْتَمُّ النَّاسُ بِالْمَأْمُومِ

chapters.name_en: Can the Imam depend on the people's saying if he is in doubt (about a certain matter)?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يَأْخُذُ الإِمَامُ إِذَا شَكَّ بِقَوْلِ النَّاسِ

chapters.name_en: If the Imam weeps in As-Salat (the prayers) (will his Salat be valid?)
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا بَكَى الإِمَامُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: Straightening the rows at the time of Iqama and after it (immediately)
chapters.name_ar: تَسْوِيَةِ الصُّفُوفِ عِنْدَ الإِقَامَةِ وَبَعْدَهَا

chapters.name_en: Facing of the Imam towards his followers while straightening the rows.
chapters.name_ar: إِقْبَالِ الإِمَامِ عَلَى النَّاسِ عِنْدَ تَسْوِيَةِ الصُّفُوفِ

chapters.name_en: The first row
chapters.name_ar: الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ

chapters.name_en: The first row
chapters.name_ar: الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ

chapters.name_en: The straightening of the rows is amongst those obligatory and good things which make your As-Salat (the prayer) a correct and perfect one.
chapters.name_ar: إِقَامَةِ الصَّفِّ مِنْ تَمَامِ الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: The sin of a person who does not complete the rows (who is out of alignment) for the prayer
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ مَنْ لَمْ يُتِمَّ الصُّفُوفَ

chapters.name_en: To stand shoulder to shoulder and foot to foot in a row
chapters.name_ar: إِلْزَاقِ الْمَنْكِبِ بِالْمَنْكِبِ وَالْقَدَمِ بِالْقَدَمِ فِي الصَّفِّ

chapters.name_en: If a person stands by the left side of the Imam, and the Imam dress him to the right from behind, the Salat (prayer) is correct.
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا قَامَ الرَّجُلُ عَنْ يَسَارِ الإِمَامِ، وَحَوَّلَهُ الإِمَامُ خَلْفَهُ إِلَى يَمِينِهِ، تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ

chapters.name_en: One woman can form a row
chapters.name_ar: الْمَرْأَةُ وَحْدَهَا تَكُونُ صَفًّا

chapters.name_en: The right side of the mosque and the place to the right of the Imam
chapters.name_ar: مَيْمَنَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَالإِمَامِ

chapters.name_en: If there is a wall or a Sutra between the Imam and followers
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَ الإِمَامِ وَبَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ حَائِطٌ أَوْ سُتْرَةٌ

chapters.name_en: The night prayer.
chapters.name_ar: صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ

chapters.name_en: The necessity of saying the Takbir, i.e., Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) and the commencement of As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: إِيجَابِ التَّكْبِيرِ وَافْتِتَاحِ الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: To raise both hands on saying the first Takbir simultaneously with opening the Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي التَّكْبِيرَةِ الأُولَى مَعَ الاِفْتِتَاحِ سَوَاءً

chapters.name_en: To raise both hands while saying the Takbir [on opening As-Salat (the prayer)], and while bowing and on raising up the head (after bowing)
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ إِذَا كَبَّرَ وَإِذَا رَكَعَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَ

chapters.name_en: To what level should one raise one's hand.
chapters.name_ar: إِلَى أَيْنَ يَرْفَعُ يَدَيْهِ

chapters.name_en: To raise one's hands after finishing the second Rak'a (on standing for the third Rak'a)
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: To place the right hand on the left [in As-Salt (the prayers)]
chapters.name_ar: وَضْعِ الْيُمْنَى عَلَى الْيُسْرَى

chapters.name_en: Submissiveness in As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: الْخُشُوعِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: What to say after the Takbir
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَقُولُ بَعْدَ التَّكْبِيرِ
باب ما يقول بعد التكبير

chapters.name_en: To cast a look at the Imam during As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى الإِمَامِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: Looking towards the sky during As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: رَفْعِ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: To look hither and thither in As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: الاِلْتِفَاتِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: Is it permissible to one to look around in Salat (prayer) if something happens to one? Or can one look at something like expectoration in the directn of the Qiblah?
chapters.name_ar: هَلْ يَلْتَفِتُ لأَمْرٍ يَنْزِلُ بِهِ أَوْ يَرَى شَيْئًا أَوْ بُصَاقًا فِي الْقِبْلَةِ

chapters.name_en: Recitation of the Qur'an (Surat Al-Fatiha) is compulsory for the Imam and the followers, at the home and on journey, in all As-Salat (the prayers) whether the recitation is done silently or aloud.
chapters.name_ar: وُجُوبِ الْقِرَاءَةِ لِلإِمَامِ وَالْمَأْمُومِ فِي الصَّلَوَاتِ كُلِّهَا فِي الْحَضَرِ وَالسَّفَرِ وَمَا يُجْهَرُ فِيهَا وَمَا يُخَافَتُ

chapters.name_en: The recitation of the Qur'an in a Zuhr prayer
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الظُّهْرِ

chapters.name_en: The recitation of the Qur'an in the 'Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: The recitation of the Qur'an in the Magrib prayer
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ

chapters.name_en: To recite aloud in the Maghrib prayer.
chapters.name_ar: الْجَهْرِ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ

chapters.name_en: To recite aloud in the 'Isha' prayer.
chapters.name_ar: الْجَهْرِ فِي الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: To recite in the 'Isha prayer, with As-Sajda(prostration)
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْعِشَاءِ بِالسَّجْدَةِ

chapters.name_en: Recitation in the 'Isha prayer
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْعِشَاءِ

chapters.name_en: Prolonging the first two Rak'a and shortening the last two
chapters.name_ar: يُطَوِّلُ فِي الأُولَيَيْنِ وَيَحْذِفُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The recitation of the Qur'an in the Fajr prayer
chapters.name_ar: الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: To recite aloud in the Fajr (early morning) prayer.
chapters.name_ar: الْجَهْرِ بِقِرَاءَةِ صَلاَةِ الْفَجْرِ

chapters.name_en: To recite two Surah in one Rak'a and to recite the last verses of some Surah, or to elite the Surah in their reverse order, or to recite the beginning of a Surah
chapters.name_ar: الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ السُّورَتَيْنِ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ
باب الجمع بين السورتين في الركعة

chapters.name_en: To recite only Surah Al-Fathiha in the last two Rak'a during a four Rak'a Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: يَقْرَأُ فِي الأُخْرَيَيْنِ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ

chapters.name_en: To recite (the Qur'an) quietly in the Zuhr and 'Asr prayers
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ خَافَتَ الْقِرَاءَةَ فِي الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: (In a quiet prayer) if the Imam recites a Verse or so audibly
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا أَسْمَعَ الإِمَامُ الآيَةَ

chapters.name_en: To prolong the first Rak'a
chapters.name_ar: يُطَوِّلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الأُولَى

chapters.name_en: Saying of Amin aloud by the Imam
chapters.name_ar: جَهْرِ الإِمَامِ بِالتَّأْمِينِ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of saying Amin
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ التَّأْمِينِ

chapters.name_en: Saying of Amin aloud by the followers
chapters.name_ar: جَهْرِ الْمَأْمُومِ بِالتَّأْمِينِ

chapters.name_en: If someone bowed behind the rows, [on entering the mosque and before joining the rows of Salat (prayer)]
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا رَكَعَ دُونَ الصَّفِّ

chapters.name_en: Itmam At-Takbir (i.e., to end the number of Takbir or to say the Takbir perfectly) on bowing. [See Fath Al-Bari]
chapters.name_ar: إِتْمَامِ التَّكْبِيرِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ

chapters.name_en: Itmam At-Takbir (i.e., to end the number of Takbir, or to say the Takbir perfectly) on prostrating. [See Fath Al-Bari]
chapters.name_ar: إِتْمَامِ التَّكْبِيرِ فِي السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: Saying the Takbir on raising from the prostration
chapters.name_ar: التَّكْبِيرِ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: To put the hands (palms) on both knees while bowing.
chapters.name_ar: وَضْعِ الأَكُفِّ عَلَى الرُّكَبِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ

chapters.name_en: Not performing bowing perfectly
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا لَمْ يُتِمَّ الرُّكُوعَ

chapters.name_en: And what is said regarding the limit of the completion of bowing and of keeping the back straight and the calmness with which it is performed.
chapters.name_ar: حَدِّ إِتْمَامِ الرُّكُوعِ وَالاِعْتِدَالِ فِيهِ وَالاِطْمَأْنِينَةِ

chapters.name_en: The order of the Prophet (pbuh) to a person who did not perform his bowing perfectly that he should repeat his Salat (prayer)
chapters.name_ar: أَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي لاَ يُتِمُّ رُكُوعَهُ بِالإِعَادَةِ

chapters.name_en: Invocation in bowing.
chapters.name_ar: الدُّعَاءِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ

chapters.name_en: What the Imam and the followers say on raising their heads from bowing.
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَقُولُ الإِمَامُ وَمَنْ خَلْفَهُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ

chapters.name_en: The superiority of saying Allahumma Rabbana lakal hand (O Allah, Our Lord!, All the praises and thanks are for You)
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ
باب فضل اللهم ربنا لك الحمد
باب فضل اللهم ربنا لك الحمد

chapters.name_en: To stand Straight with calmness on raising the head from bowing
chapters.name_ar: الاِطْمَأْنِينَةِ حِينَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ

chapters.name_en: One should say Takbir while going in prostration.
chapters.name_ar: يَهْوِي بِالتَّكْبِيرِ حِينَ يَسْجُدُ

chapters.name_en: Superiority of prostrating.
chapters.name_ar: فَضْلِ السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: During the prostrations one should keep one's arms away from one's sides and the abdomen should be kept away from the thighs.
chapters.name_ar: يُبْدِي ضَبْعَيْهِ وَيُجَافِي فِي السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: If one does not perform the prostrations perfectly
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا لَمْ يُتِمَّ السُّجُودَ

chapters.name_en: To prostrate on seven bones
chapters.name_ar: السُّجُودِ عَلَى سَبْعَةِ أَعْظُمٍ

chapters.name_en: To prostrate on the nose
chapters.name_ar: السُّجُودِ عَلَى الأَنْفِ

chapters.name_en: To prostrate on the nose and in the mud
chapters.name_ar: السُّجُودِ عَلَى الأَنْفِ وَالسُّجُودِ عَلَى الطِّينِ

chapters.name_en: To tie the clothes and wrap them properly [in Salat (prayer)]; and whoever gathered his clothes for fear that his private parts may become exposed.
chapters.name_ar: عَقْدِ الثِّيَابِ وَشَدِّهَا

chapters.name_en: One should not tuck put the hair [during Salat (prayers)]
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَكُفُّ شَعَرًا

chapters.name_en: One should not tuck up his garment in As-Salat (the prayer)
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَكُفُّ ثَوْبَهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ

chapters.name_en: To invoke and glorify Allah in prostration
chapters.name_ar: التَّسْبِيحِ وَالدُّعَاءِ فِي السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: To sit for a while between the two prostrations
chapters.name_ar: الْمُكْثِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: To sit for a while between the two prostrations
chapters.name_ar: الْمُكْثِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: One should not put the forearms on the ground during prostrations
chapters.name_ar: لاَ يَفْتَرِشُ ذِرَاعَيْهِ فِي السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: Sitting Straight in a Witr payer (i.e., an odd Rak'a) and then getting up.
chapters.name_ar: مَنِ اسْتَوَى قَاعِدًا فِي وِتْرٍ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ ثُمَّ نَهَضَ

chapters.name_en: How to support oneself on the ground while standing after finishing the Rak'a (after the two prostrations)
chapters.name_ar: كَيْفَ يَعْتَمِدُ عَلَى الأَرْضِ إِذَا قَامَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَةِ

chapters.name_en: Saying Takbir on rising from the two prostrations
chapters.name_ar: يُكَبِّرُ وَهْوَ يَنْهَضُ مِنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The Prophet's Sunna (legal way) for the sitting in the Tashah-hud [in the Salat (prayer)].
chapters.name_ar: سُنَّةِ الْجُلُوسِ فِي التَّشَهُّدِ

chapters.name_en: Whoever considered that the first Tashah-hud is not compulsory
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ التَّشَهُّدَ الأَوَّلَ وَاجِبًا لأَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَامَ مِنَ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ وَلَمْ يَرْجِعْ

chapters.name_en: (Saying of the) Tashah-hud in the first sitting.
chapters.name_ar: التَّشَهُّدِ فِي الأُولَى

chapters.name_en: (Saying of the) Tashah-hud in the last Rak'a
chapters.name_ar: التَّشَهُّدِ فِي الآخِرَةِ

chapters.name_en: Invocation before the Taslim
chapters.name_ar: الدُّعَاءِ قَبْلَ السَّلاَمِ

chapters.name_en: Invocation before the Taslim
