chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «لاَ تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ يُقَاتِلُونَ». وَهُمْ أَهْلُ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: “…or to cover you with confusion in party strife…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًا‏}‏

chapters.name_en: Comparing an ambiguous situation to a clear well-defined one
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ شَبَّهَ أَصْلاً مَعْلُومًا بِأَصْلٍ مُبَيَّنٍ قَدْ بَيَّنَ اللَّهُ حُكْمَهُمَا، لِيُفْهِمَ السَّائِلَ

chapters.name_en: Exerting oneself to find out the proper legal verdict which is in harmony with what Allah has revealed
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي اجْتِهَادِ الْقُضَاةِ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

chapters.name_en: Exerting oneself to find out the proper legal verdict which is in harmony with what Allah has revealed
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي اجْتِهَادِ الْقُضَاةِ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى

chapters.name_en: “Certainly you will follow the ways of those who were before you.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَتَتْبَعُنَّ سَنَنَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: The sin of the person who invites others to an evil deed or establishes a bad tradition
chapters.name_ar: إِثْمِ مَنْ دَعَا إِلَى ضَلاَلَةٍ أَوْ سَنَّ سُنَّةً سَيِّئَةً

chapters.name_en: The religious learned men should not differ
chapters.name_ar: مَا ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَضَّ عَلَى اتِّفَاقِ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: The religious learned men should not differ
chapters.name_ar: مَا ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَضَّ عَلَى اتِّفَاقِ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ

chapters.name_en: “Not for you is the decision…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ الأَمْرِ شَيْءٌ}

chapters.name_en: “…But, man is ever more quarrelsome than anything.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {وَكَانَ الإِنْسَانُ أَكْثَرَ شَيْءٍ جَدَلاً}

chapters.name_en: “Thus We have made you a just nation…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {وَكَذَلِكَ جَعَلْنَاكُمْ أُمَّةً وَسَطًا}

chapters.name_en: A verdict based on opinion proves to be wrong then the verdict will be rejected
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا اجْتَهَدَ الْعَامِلُ أَوِ الْحَاكِمُ فَأَخْطَأَ خِلاَفَ الرَّسُولِ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، فَحُكْمُهُ مَرْدُودٌ

chapters.name_en: A verdict based on opinion proves to be wrong then the verdict will be rejected
chapters.name_ar: إِذَا اجْتَهَدَ الْعَامِلُ أَوِ الْحَاكِمُ فَأَخْطَأَ خِلاَفَ الرَّسُولِ مِنْ غَيْرِ عِلْمٍ، فَحُكْمُهُ مَرْدُودٌ

chapters.name_en: The reward for giving a verdict according to the best of knowledge
chapters.name_ar: أَجْرِ الْحَاكِمِ إِذَا اجْتَهَدَ فَأَصَابَ أَوْ أَخْطَأَ

chapters.name_en: Some Companions did not witness certain deeds or did hear certain saying of the Prophet (saws)
chapters.name_ar: الْحُجَّةِ عَلَى مَنْ قَالَ إِنَّ أَحْكَامَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَتْ ظَاهِرَةً

chapters.name_en: If the Prophet (saws) did not disapprove of something
chapters.name_ar: مَنْ رَأَى تَرْكَ النَّكِيرِ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُجَّةً لاَ مِنْ غَيْرِ الرَّسُولِ

chapters.name_en: The laws inferred from certain evidences; and the meaning of an evidence
chapters.name_ar: الأَحْكَامِ الَّتِي تُعْرَفُ بِالدَّلاَئِلِ، وَكَيْفَ مَعْنَى الدِّلاَلَةِ وَتَفْسِيرِهَا

chapters.name_en: “Do not ask the people of the Scripture about anything.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَسْأَلُوا أَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ عَنْ شَىْءٍ ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: It is disliked to differ
chapters.name_ar: كَرَاهِيَةِ الْخِلاَفِ

chapters.name_en: Something forbidden by the Prophet (saws) is legally prohibited
chapters.name_ar: نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَى التَّحْرِيمِ إِلاَّ مَا تُعْرَفُ إِبَاحَتُهُ

chapters.name_en: “…And who (conduct) their affair by mutual consultation…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى: {وَأَمْرُهُمْ شُورَى بَيْنَهُمْ}

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saws) inviting his followers to Tauhid of Allah
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَّتَهُ إِلَى تَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَلَى

chapters.name_en: “Say: Invoke Allah or invoke the Most Gracious, by whatever name you invoke Him, for to Him belong the Best Names.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تبارك وتعالى: {قل ادعوا الله أو ادعوا الرحمن أيا ما تدعوا فله الأسماء الحسنى} [الإسراء: 110

chapters.name_en: “Verily Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين} [الذاريات: 58

chapters.name_en: “(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Unseen, and He reveals to none His Unseen.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين} [الذاريات: 58

chapters.name_en: “…the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏السَّلاَمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “The King of mankind.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏مَلِكِ النَّاسِ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَهْوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “And it is He Who has created the heavens and the earth in truth…”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {وهو الذي خلق السموات والأرض بالحق}

chapters.name_en: “And Allah is Ever All-Hearer, All-Seer.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَكَانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا‏}

chapters.name_en: “And Allah is Ever All-Hearer, All-Seer.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَكَانَ اللَّهُ سَمِيعًا بَصِيرًا‏}

chapters.name_en: “Say: He has power to (send torment on you from above)…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏قُلْ هُوَ الْقَادِرُ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: The One Who turns the hearts
chapters.name_ar: باب مقلب القلوب

chapters.name_en: Allah has one hundred Names less One
chapters.name_ar: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مِائَةَ اسْمٍ إِلاَّ وَاحِدًا

chapters.name_en: Asking Allah with His Names and seeking refuge with them
chapters.name_ar: السُّؤَالِ بِأَسْمَاءِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى، وَالاِسْتِعَاذَةِ بِهَا

chapters.name_en: Adh-Dhat, His Qualities and His Names
chapters.name_ar: مَا يُذْكَرُ فِي الذَّاتِ وَالنُّعُوتِ وَأَسَامِي اللَّهِ

chapters.name_en: “…And Allah warns you against Himself…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى {‏وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللَّهُ نَفْسَهُ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “…..Everything will perish save His Face…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏كُلُّ شَىْءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلاَّ وَجْهَهُ‏}

chapters.name_en: “…In order that you may be brought up under My Eye.
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَى عَيْنِي‏}‏ تُغَذَّى

chapters.name_en: “He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor of all things, the Bestower of forms…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ}

chapters.name_en: “..To one whom I have created with Both My Hands…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “..To one whom I have created with Both My Hands…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “No person has more Ghaira than Allah.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ شَخْصَ أَغْيَرُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: “Say ‘What thing is the most great in witness?’ Say: ‘Allah…’”
chapters.name_ar: ‏{‏قُلْ أَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً قُلِ اللَّهُ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “…And His Throne was on the water…”
chapters.name_ar: باب {وكان عرشه على الماء} [هود: 7]، {وهو رب العرش العظيم} [التوبة: 129

chapters.name_en: “…And His Throne was on the water…”
chapters.name_ar: باب {وكان عرشه على الماء} [هود: 7]، {وهو رب العرش العظيم} [التوبة: 129

chapters.name_en: “The angels and the Ruh ascend to Him…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏تَعْرُجُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ}

chapters.name_en: “Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah. Looking at their Lord.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {وجوه يومئذ ناضرة إلى ربها ناظرة} [القيامة: 23

chapters.name_en: “Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah. Looking at their Lord.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {وجوه يومئذ ناضرة إلى ربها ناظرة} [القيامة: 23

chapters.name_en: “…Surely, Allah’s Mercy is near unto the good-doers.”
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّ رَحْمَةَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ}

chapters.name_en: “Verily, Allah grasps the heavens and the earth lest they move away from their places…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمْسِكُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولاَ}

chapters.name_en: The creation of the heavens, earth and other created beings
chapters.name_ar: مَا جَاءَ فِي تَخْلِيقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِنَ الْخَلاَئِقِ

chapters.name_en: “And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves – the Messengers”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا الْمُرْسَلِينَ}

chapters.name_en: “Verily! Our Word unto a thing when We intend it.…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ‏ إذا أردناه أن نقول له كن فيكون}‏

chapters.name_en: “Say: If the sea were ink for the Words of my Lord, surely the sea would be exhausted…”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول الله تعالى: {قل لو كان البحر مدادا لكلمات ربي لنفد البحر قبل أن تنفد كلمات ربي ولو جئنا بمثله مددا} [الكهف: 109

chapters.name_en: (Allah’s) Wish and Will
chapters.name_ar: فِي الْمَشِيئَةِ وَالإِرَادَةِ

chapters.name_en: “Intercession with Him profits not, except for him whom He permits….’
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَلاَ تَنْفَعُ الشَّفَاعَةُ عِنْدَهُإِلاَّ لِمَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا فُزِّعَ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ قَالُوا مَاذَا قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُوا الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ}

chapters.name_en: The Talk of the Lord with Jibril and Allah’s Call for the angels
chapters.name_ar: كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ جِبْرِيلَ وَنِدَاءِ اللَّهِ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ

chapters.name_en: “…He has sent it down with His Knowledge, and the angels bear witness….”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏أَنْزَلَهُ بِعِلْمِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُيَشْهَدُونَ}

chapters.name_en: “…They want to change Allah’s Words….”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}

chapters.name_en: “…They want to change Allah’s Words….”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يُرِيدُونَ أَنْ يُبَدِّلُوا كَلاَمَ اللَّهِ}

chapters.name_en: The Talk of the Lord عزّ وجلّ to the  Prophets and others on the Day of Resurrection
chapters.name_ar: كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَغَيْرِهِمْ

chapters.name_en: “…And to Musa (Moses) Allah spoke directly.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏وَكَلَّمَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى تَكْلِيمًا‏}‏

chapters.name_en: The Talk of the Lord to the people of Paradise
chapters.name_ar: كَلاَمِ الرَّبِّ مَعَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ

chapters.name_en: “….Then do not set up rivals unto Allah while you know.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَلاَ تَجْعَلُوا لِلَّهِ أَنْدَادًا‏}

chapters.name_en: “And you have not been hiding yourselves, lest your ears, and your eyes and your skins testify against you, but you thought that Allah knew not much of what you were doing.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَمَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُونَ أَنْ يَشْهَدَ عَلَيْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَلاَ أَبْصَارُكُمْ وَلاَ جُلُودُكُمْ وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ أَنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَثِيرًا مِمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ}

chapters.name_en: “….Every day He is in some affair!”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِي شَأْنٍ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “Move not your tongue concerning to make haste therewith.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ‏}‏

chapters.name_en: “And whether you keep your talk secret or disclose it. Verily, He is the All-Knower of what is in the breasts (of men)….”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوابِهِ إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ أَلاَ يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ}

chapters.name_en: ‘If I have been given what this man has been given, I would do the same as he is doing.’
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏رَجُلٌ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْقُرْآنَ فَهْوَ يَقُومُ بِهِ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَرَجُلٌ يَقُولُ لَوْ أُوتِيتُ مِثْلَ مَا أُوتِيَ هَذَا فَعَلْتُ كَمَا يَفْعَلُ»

chapters.name_en: “O Messenger! Proclaim which has been sent down to you from your Lord. And if you do not, then you have not conveyed His Message…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ بَلِّغْ مَاأُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَإِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلْ فَمَا بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالاَتِهِ}

chapters.name_en: “…Say Bring here the Taurat and recite it…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏قُلْ فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا}

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saws) called As-Salat a deed and said, “Whoever does not recite Al-Fatiha of the Book in his Salat, his Salat is invalid
chapters.name_ar: وَسَمَّى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ عَمَلاً

chapters.name_en: “Verily, man was created very impatient. Irritable when evil touches him. And niggardly when good touches him.”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏إِنَّ الإِنْسَانَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا * إِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا * وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ الْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا}

chapters.name_en: What the Prophet (saws) mentioned and narrated of his Lord’s Sayings
chapters.name_ar: ذِكْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ رَبِّهِ

chapters.name_en: What is allowed as regards the interpretation of the Taurat and other Holy Books
chapters.name_ar: مَا يَجُوزُ مِنْ تَفْسِيرِ التَّوْرَاةِ وَغَيْرِهَا مِنْ كُتُبِ اللَّهِ بِالْعَرَبِيَّةِ وَغَيْرِهَا

chapters.name_en: “A person who is perfect in reciting and memorizing the Qur'an will be with the honourable, pious and just scribes.”
chapters.name_ar: باب قول النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: «الماهر بالقرآن مع الكرام البررة»

chapters.name_en: “…So recite as much of the Qur'an as may be easy for you….”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏فَاقْرَءُوا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ}

chapters.name_en: “And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember….’
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ لِلذِّكْرِ}

chapters.name_en: “Nay! This is a Glorious Qur'an, in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz.
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ * فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ}

chapters.name_en: “While Allah has created you and what you make!”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ}

chapters.name_en: The recitation of the Qur'an by an impious person or a hypocrite
chapters.name_ar: قِرَاءَةِ الْفَاجِرِ وَالْمُنَافِقِ، وَأَصْوَاتُهُمْ وَتِلاَوَتُهُمْ لاَ تُجَاوِزُ حَنَاجِرَهُمْ

chapters.name_en: “And We shall set up Balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection…”
chapters.name_ar: قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏{‏وَنَضَعُ الْمَوَازِينَ الْقِسْطَ‏ لِيَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ}

muslim.description: Al-Musnad al-Sahih. Second in rank after al-Bukhari; famous for gathering all chains of a hadith in one place.
muslim.edition: Dar Ihya' al-Turath al-'Arabi, Beirut, ed. Muhammad Fu'ad 'Abd al-Baqi, 5 vols

books.name_en: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer
The Book of Prayer - Two Eids
The Book of the Rules of Inheritance
The Book of Oaths, Muharibin, Qasas (Retaliation), and Diyat (Blood Money)
The Book of Jihad and Expeditions
The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
books.name_ar: كتاب الصيد والذبائح وما يؤكل من الحيوان

books.name_en: The Book of Clothes and Adornment
The Book of Manners and Etiquette
The Book Concerning the Use of Correct Words
The Book of the Merits of the Companions
books.name_ar: كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم

books.name_en: The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
Characteristics of The Hypocrites And Rulings Concerning Them
Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
The Book of Zuhd and Softening of Hearts
The Book of Commentary on the Qur'an

chapters.name_ar: باب في التحذير من الكذب على رسول الله صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم
باب النهي عن الحديث بكل ما سمع
باب في الضعفاء والكذابين ومن يرغب عن حديثهم

chapters.name_en: Explaining Al-Iman (Faith), Al-Islam, and Al-Ihsan, and The Obligations of Al-Iman With Affirmation of The Qadar of Allah, Glorious And Most High is He. And Explaining The Evidence For Declaring One's Innocence Of One Who Does Not Believe In Al-Qadar, And Having A Harsh View Of His Case
chapters.name_ar: باب بيان الإيمان والإسلام والإحسان ووجوب الإيمان بإثبات قدر الله سبحانه وتعالى وبيان الدليل على التبري ممن لا يؤمن بالقدر وإغلاظ القول في حقه

chapters.name_en: What is Al-Iman (Faith)? Explaining Its Characteristics
chapters.name_ar: باب الإِيمَانُ مَا هُوَ وَبَيَانُ خِصَالِهِ

chapters.name_en: What is Islam? Explaining its characteristics.
chapters.name_ar: باب الإِسْلاَمُ مَا هُوَ وَبَيَانُ خِصَالِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Explaining the prayers which are one of the pillars of Islam
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ الصَّلَوَاتِ الَّتِي هِيَ أَحَدُ أَرْكَانِ الإِسْلاَمِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Asking about the pillars of Islam
chapters.name_ar: باب السُّؤَالِ عَنْ أَرْكَانِ الْإِسْلَامِ

chapters.name_en: Explaining the faith by means of which a person is admitted into paradise, and that the one who adheres to what is enjoined upon him will enter paradise
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ الإِيمَانِ الَّذِي يُدْخَلُ بِهِ الْجَنَّةُ وَأَنَّ مَنْ تَمَسَّكَ بِمَا أُمِرَ بِهِ دَخَلَ الجَنَّةَ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the pillars of Islam and its grand supports
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَرْكَانِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَدَعَائِمِهِ الْعِظَامِ

chapters.name_en: The command to believe in Allah and His Messenger (saws) and the laws of Islam, calling people to it, asking about it, memorizing it and conveying it to those who have not heard the message
chapters.name_ar: باب الْأَمْرِ بِالْإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ تَعَالَى وَرَسُولِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَشَرَائِعِ الدِّينِ

chapters.name_en: Calling people to the twin declaration of faith and the laws of Islam
chapters.name_ar: باب الدُّعَاءِ إِلَى الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ وَشَرَائِعِ الإِسْلاَمِ

chapters.name_en: The command to fight the people until they say "La ilaha illallah Muhammad Rasul-Allah", and establish Salat, and pay the Zakat, and believe in everything that the prophet (saws) brought. Whoever does that, his life and his wealth are protected except by its right, and his secrets are entrusted to Allah, the most high. Fighting those who withhold Zakat or other than that is one of the duties of Islam and the Iman should be concerned with the Laws of Islam
chapters.name_ar: باب الأَمْرِ بِقِتَالِ النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَقُولُوا لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Evidence that the islam of one who becomes muslim on his deathbed is valid, so long as the death thoes have not begun; Abrogation of permission to supplicate for forgiveness for the idolators; Evidence that one who dies an idolator is one of the people of hell and no intervention can save him from that
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ مَنْ مَاتَ عَلَى التَّوْحِيدِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ قَطْعًا

chapters.name_en: The evidence that one who dies believing in tawhid will definitely enter paradise
chapters.name_ar: باب مَنْ لَقِيَ اللَّهَ بِالإِيمَانِ وَهُوَ غَيْرُ شَاكٍّ فِيهِ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَحَرُمَ عَلَى النَّارِ

chapters.name_en: Evidence that the one who is content with Allah as his Lord, Islam as his religion and Muhammad (saws) as his prophet, then he is a believer, even if he commits major sins
chapters.name_ar: بَاب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ مَنْ رَضِيَ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَإِنْ ارْتَكَبَ الْمَعَاصِيَ الْكَبَائِرَ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the number of branches of faith, the best and the least of them, the virtue of modesty (Al-Haya') and the fact that it is part of faith
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ عَدَدِ شُعَبِ الْإِيمَانِ وَأَفْضَلِهَا وَأَدْنَاهَا وَفَضِيلَةِ الْحَيَاءِ وَكَوْنِهِ مِنْ الْإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: A phrase that sums up Islam
chapters.name_ar: باب جَامِعِ أَوْصَافِ الإِسْلاَمِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the superiority of Islam, and what part of it is best
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ تَفَاضُلِ الإِسْلاَمِ وَأَىِّ أُمُورِهِ أَفْضَلُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarification of those characteristics which, if a person attains them, he will find the sweetness of faith
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ خِصَالٍ مَنِ اتَّصَفَ بِهِنَّ وَجَدَ حَلاَوَةَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: The obligation to love the messenger of Allah (saws) more than one's family, son, father, and all other people; And mentions of an absolute absence of faith regarding one who does not love him with such love
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ مَحَبَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَكْثَرَ مِنَ الأَهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَالْوَالِدِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ وَإِطْلاَقِ عَدَمِ الإِيمَانِ عَلَى مَنْ لَمْ يُحِبَّهُ هَذِهِ الْمَحَبَّةَ

chapters.name_en: The evidence that one of the attributes of faith is to love for one's brother muslim that one loves for oneself of goodness
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ مِنْ خِصَالِ الإِيمَانِ أَنْ يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِه مِنَ الْخَيْرِ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the prohibition of annoying one's neighbor
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ تَحْرِيمِ إِيذَاءِ الْجَارِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Encouragement to honor one's neighbor and guest, and the obligation to remain silent unless one has something good to say, and the fact that all of that is part of faith
chapters.name_ar: باب الْحَثِّ عَلَى إِكْرَامِ الْجَارِ وَالضَّيْفِ وَلُزُومِ الصَّمْتِ إِلاَّ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَكَوْنِ ذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that forbidding evil is part of faith, faith increases and decreases; Enjoying what is good and forbidding what is evil are obligatory
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ كَوْنِ النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ، مِنَ الإِيمَانِ وَأَنَّ الإِيمَانَ يَزِيدُ وَيَنْقُصُ وَأَنَّ الأَمْرَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْيَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَاجِبَانِ

chapters.name_en: People excel over one another in faith, and the superiority of the people of Yemen in faith
chapters.name_ar: باب تَفَاضُلِ أَهْلِ الإِيمَانِ فِيهِ وَرُجْحَانِ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ فِيهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that no one will enter paradise but the believers; loving the believers is part of faith and spreading Salam is a means of attaining that
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَنَّ مَحَبَّةَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ وَأَنَّ إِفْشَاءَ السَّلاَمِ سَبَبٌ لِحُصُولِهَا

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that the religion is sincerity
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الدِّينَ النَّصِيحَةُ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that faith decreases because of disobedience and negating it from the one committing the act of disobedience, with the meaning of negating its completion
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ نُقْصَانِ الإِيمَانِ بِالْمَعَاصِي وَنَفْيِهِ عَنِ الْمُتَلَبِّسِ بِالْمَعْصِيَةِ عَلَى إِرَادَةِ نَفْيِ كَمَالِهِ

chapters.name_en: The characteristics of the hypocrite
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ خِصَالِ الْمُنَافِقِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the condition of faith for one who says to his muslim brother: "O Kafir (Disbeliever)."
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ حَالِ إِيمَانِ مَنْ قَالَ لأَخِيهِ الْمُسْلِمِ يَا كَافِرُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the condition of the fath of one who knowingly denies his father
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ حَالِ إِيمَانِ مَنْ رَغِبَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَهُوَ يَعْلَمُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the words of the prophet (saws): "Insulting A Muslim is an evil action and fighting him is disbelief (Kufr)"
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سِبَابُ الْمُسْلِمِ فُسُوقٌ وَقِتَالُهُ كُفْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the meaning of the Statement of the Prophet (saws): "Do not revert to disbelief (Kuffar) after I am Gone, striking one another's necks"
chapters.name_ar: باب ‏"‏ لاَ تَرْجِعُوا بَعْدِي كُفَّارًا يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Use of the word Kufr with regard to slandering people's lineage and wailing
chapters.name_ar: باب إِطْلاَقِ اسْمِ الْكُفْرِ عَلَى الطَّعْنِ فِي النَّسَبِ وَالنِّيَاحَةِ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Calling a runaway slave a kafirg
chapters.name_ar: باب تَسْمِيَةِ الْعَبْدِ الآبِقِ كَافِرًا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the Kufr of one who says: "We got rain because of the stars."
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ كُفْرِ مَنْ قَالَ مُطِرْنَا بِالنَّوْءِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Evidence that love of the Ansar and Ali (r.a.) is a part of faith and a sign thereof; Hating them is a sign of hypocrisy
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ حُبَّ الأَنْصَارِ وَعَلِيٍّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ وَعَلاَمَاتِهِ وَبُغْضَهُمْ مِنْ عَلاَمَاتِ النِّفَاقِ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that faith decreases with shortcoming in obedience, and the word Kufr may be used with regard to matters other than dsbelief in Allah, such as ingratitude for blessings and not fulfilling one's duties
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ نُقْصَانِ الإِيمَانِ بِنَقْصِ الطَّاعَاتِ وَبَيَانِ إِطْلاَقِ لَفْظِ الْكُفْرِ عَلَى غَيْرِ الْكُفْرِ بِاللَّهِ كَكُفْرِ النِّعْمَةِ وَالْحُقُوقِ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the usage of the word Kafir for one who abandons Salat
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ إِطْلاَقِ اسْمِ الْكُفْرِ عَلَى مَنْ تَرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that faith in Allah most high is the best of deeds
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ كَوْنِ الإِيمَانِ بِاللَّهِ تَعَالَى أَفْضَلَ الأَعْمَالِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that Shirk is the worst of sins, and the worst sins after Shirk
chapters.name_ar: باب كَوْنِ الشِّرْكِ أَقْبَحَ الذُّنُوبِ وَبَيَانِ أَعْظَمِهَا بَعْدَهُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The major sins and the most serious of them
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ الْكَبَائِرِ وَأَكْبَرِهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of pride and definition of it
chapters.name_ar: باب تَحْرِيمِ الْكِبْرِ وَبَيَانِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence that the one who dies not associating anything with Allah will enter paradise, and the one who dies as idolator will enter the fire
chapters.name_ar: باب مَنْ مَاتَ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَمَنْ مَاتَ مُشْرِكًا دَخَلَ النَّارَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of killing a disbeliever after he says La ilaha illallah
chapters.name_ar: باب تَحْرِيمِ قَتْلِ الْكَافِرِ بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The Saying of the prophet (saws): "Whoever bears weapons against us is not one of us."
chapters.name_ar: باب قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ - صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم - ‏"‏ مَنْ حَمَل عَلَيْنَا السِّلاَحَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏ ‏

chapters.name_en: The Saying of the prophet (saws): "Whoever deceives us is not one of us."
chapters.name_ar: باب قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ - صلى الله تعالى عليه وسلم - ‏"‏ مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا ‏"‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of striking one's checks, tearing one's garment and calling with the calls of Jahilliyyah
chapters.name_ar: باب تَحْرِيمِ ضَرْبِ الْخُدُودِ وَشَقِّ الْجُيُوبِ وَالدُّعَاءِ بِدَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the emphatic prohibition of An-Namimah (Malicious Gossip)
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ غِلَظِ تَحْرِيمِ النَّمِيمَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the emphatic prohibition of letting one's garment hang below the ankles (isbal), reminding others of one's gift and selling goods by means of a false oath; Mention of the three to whom Allah, Most High, will not speak on the day of resurrection, nor look at them, nor sanctify them, and theirs will be a painful torment
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ غِلَظِ تَحْرِيمِ إِسْبَالِ الإِزَارِ وَالْمَنِّ بِالْعَطِيَّةِ وَتَنْفِيقِ السِّلْعَةِ بِالْحَلِفِ وَبَيَانِ الثَّلاَثَةِ الَّذِينَ لاَ يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلاَ يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the emphatic prohibition against killing oneself; The one who kills himself with something will be punished with it in the fire; And that no one will enter Paradise but a muslim
chapters.name_ar: باب غِلَظِ تَحْرِيمِ قَتْلِ الإِنْسَانِ نَفْسَهُ وَإِنَّ مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْسَهُ بِشَيْءٍ عُذِّبَ بِهِ فِي النَّارِ وَأَنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ نَفْسٌ مُسْلِمَةٌ

chapters.name_en: Emphatic prohibition against stealing from the spoils of war; and that no one will enter paradise except the believers
chapters.name_ar: باب غِلَظِ تَحْرِيمِ الْغُلُولِ وَأَنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence that the one who kills himself is not considered a disbeliever
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ قَاتِلَ نَفْسِهِ لاَ يَكْفُرُ

chapters.name_en: Regarding the wind which will come just before the resurrection and take the soul of anyone who has any fath in his heart
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي الرِّيحِ الَّتِي تَكُونُ قُرْبَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَقْبِضُ مَنْ فِي قَلْبِهِ شَىْءٌ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ

chapters.name_en: Encouragement to hasten to do good deeds before the emergence of the Fitnah
chapters.name_ar: باب الْحَثِّ عَلَى الْمُبَادَرَةِ بِالأَعْمَالِ قَبْلَ تَظَاهُرِ الْفِتَنِ

chapters.name_en: The believer's fear that his good deeds may be lost
chapters.name_ar: باب مَخَافَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ يَحْبَطَ عَمَلُهُ

chapters.name_en: Will a person be punished for his actions during the Jahlilliyyah?
chapters.name_ar: باب هَلْ يُؤَاخَذُ بِأَعْمَالِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ

chapters.name_en: Islam destroys that which came before it, as do Hijrah (Emigration) and Hajj
chapters.name_ar: باب كَوْنِ الإِسْلاَمِ يَهْدِمُ مَا قَبْلَهُ وَكَذَا الْهِجْرَةُ وَالْحَجُّ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the ruling of the action of an unbeliever if he accepts Islam after it
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ حُكْمِ عَمَلِ الْكَافِرِ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ بَعْدَهُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Sincerity of Faith and its Purity
chapters.name_ar: باب صِدْقِ الإِيمَانِ وَإِخْلاَصِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarification that Allah, most high allows a person's thoughts and whatever occurs in his heart, so long as they do not become established, and the clarification that he, glorious is he and most high, does not burden anyone with more than he can bear, and clarifying the ruling on thinking of doing good and bad deeds
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى لَمْ يُكَلِّفْ إِلَّا مَا يُطَاقُ

chapters.name_en: Allah allows a person's thoughts and whatever occurs in his heart so long as they do not become established
chapters.name_ar: باب تَجَاوُزِ اللَّهِ عَنْ حَدِيثِ النَّفْسِ، وَالْخَوَاطِرِ، بِالْقَلْبِ إِذَا لَمْ تَسْتَقِرَّ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: If a person thinks of doing a good deed it will be recorded for him, and if he thinks of doing a bad deed it will not be recorded for him
chapters.name_ar: باب إِذَا هَمَّ الْعَبْدُ بِحَسَنَةٍ كُتِبَتْ وَإِذَا هَمَّ بِسَيِّئَةٍ لَمْ تُكْتَبْ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the Waswasah (Whispers, Bad Thoughts) with regard to faith, and what the one who experiences that should say
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ الْوَسْوَسَةِ فِي الإِيمَانِ وَمَا يَقُولُهُ مَنْ وَجَدَهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Warning of the Fire for the one who swears a false oath in order to unlawfully take the right of another muslim
chapters.name_ar: باب وَعِيدِ مَنِ اقْتَطَعَ حَقَّ مُسْلِمٍ بِيَمِينٍ فَاجِرَةٍ بِالنَّارِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence that the blood of one who aims to seize other people's wealth without right may be shed, if he is killed he will be in the fire, and the one who is killed defending his property is a martyr
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ مَنْ قَصَدَ أَخْذَ مَالِ غَيْرِهِ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ كَانَ الْقَاصِدُ مُهْدَرَ الدَّمِ فِي حَقِّهِ وَإِنْ قُتِلَ كَانَ فِي النَّارِ وَأَنَّ مَنْ قُتِلَ دُونَ مَالِهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ

chapters.name_en: One in charge of a matter, who cheats his subjects, deserves the fire
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْقَاقِ الْوَالِي الْغَاشِّ لِرَعِيَّتِهِ النَّارَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The disappearance of honesty and faith from some hearts and the appearance of fitnah in some hearts
chapters.name_ar: باب رَفْعِ الأَمَانَةِ وَالإِيمَانِ مِنْ بَعْضِ الْقُلُوبِ وَعَرْضِ الْفِتَنِ عَلَى الْقُلُوبِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that Islam started as something strange, and will revert to being something strange, and it will retreat between the two Masajid
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الْإِسْلَامَ بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا وَسَيَعُودُ غَرِيبًا وَأَنَّهُ يَأْرِزُ بَيْنَ الْمَسْجِدَيْنِ

chapters.name_en: The Disappearance of Faith at the End of Time
chapters.name_ar: باب ذَهَابِ الإِيمَانِ آخِرَ الزَّمَانِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Permissibility of concealing one's faith in the case of fear
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ الاِسْتِسْرَارِ لِلْخَائِفِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Being kind to one for whose faith there is concern because it is weak; Prohibition of attributing Faith to someone without definitive evidence
chapters.name_ar: باب تَأَلُّفِ قَلْبِ مَنْ يَخَافُ عَلَى إِيمَانِهِ لِضَعْفِهِ وَالنَّهْيِ عَنِ الْقَطْعِ بِالإِيمَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِ دَلِيلٍ قَاطِعٍ

chapters.name_en: Increasing the heart's tranquility with the appearance evidence
chapters.name_ar: باب زِيَادَةِ طُمَأْنِينَةِ الْقَلْبِ بِتَظَاهُرِ الأَدِلَّةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Obligation of believing that the message of our Prophet Muhammad (saws) is for all people, and the abrogation of all other religions
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ الإِيمَانِ بِرِسَالَةِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى جَمِيعِ النَّاسِ وَنَسْخِ الْمِلَلِ بِمِلَّتِهِ

chapters.name_en: The descent of 'Eisa bin Mariam to judge according to the Shari'ah of our Prophet Muhammad (saws); And how Allah has honored this Ummah; And clarifying the evidence that this religion will not be abrogated; and that a group from it will continue to adhere to the truth and prevail until the day of resurrection
chapters.name_ar: باب نُزُولِ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ حَاكِمًا بِشَرِيعَةِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم

chapters.name_en: Clarifying the time when faith will no longer be accepted
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ الزَّمَنِ الَّذِي لاَ يُقْبَلُ فِيهِ الإِيمَانُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The beginning of the revelation to the messenger of Allah (saws)
chapters.name_ar: باب بَدْءِ الْوَحْىِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The night journey on which the messenger of Allah (saws) was taken up into the heavens and the prayers were enjoined
chapters.name_ar: باب الإِسْرَاءِ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى السَّمَوَاتِ وَفَرْضِ الصَّلَوَاتِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Mentioning Al-Masih Son of Mariam and Al-Masih ad-Dajjal
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي ذِكْرِ الْمَسِيحِ ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَالْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: About (The Lote-Tree of the Utmost Boundary)
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي ذِكْرِ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The Meaning of the Saying of Allah, The Mighty and Sublime: And indeed he saw him at a second descent (another time)"; And did the prophet (saws) see his lord on the night of the Isra?
chapters.name_ar: باب مَعْنَى قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ: {وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَى} وَهَلْ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ رَبَّهُ لَيْلَةَ الإِسْرَاءِ

chapters.name_en: The saying of the Prophet (saws): "Light, How could I see Him?" and: "I saw Light"
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي قَوْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏"‏ نُورٌ أَنَّى أَرَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ رَأَيْتُ نُورًا

chapters.name_en: The saying of the Prophet (saws): "Allah does not sleep" and "His veil is light, and if he were to remove it, the splendour of his face would burn all of his creation, as far as hs sght reaches".
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي قَوْلِهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنَامُ». وَفِي قَوْلِهِ: «حِجَابُهُ النُّورُ لَوْ كَشَفَهُ لأَحْرَقَ سُبُحَاتُ وَجْهِهِ مَا انْتَهَى إِلَيْهِ بَصَرُهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ»

chapters.name_en: Affirming that the believers will see their Lord, Glorious is he and most high, in the hereafter
chapters.name_ar: باب إِثْبَاتِ رُؤْيَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الآخِرَةِ رَبَّهُمْ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Knowing about the seeing
chapters.name_ar: باب مَعْرِفَةِ طَرِيقِ الرُّؤْيَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Intercession and bringing those who believed in tawhid out of the Fire
chapters.name_ar: باب إِثْبَاتِ الشَّفَاعَةِ وَإِخْرَاجِ الْمُوَحِّدِينَ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The Last of the people of the Fire to be brought out of it
chapters.name_ar: باب آخِرِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ خُرُوجًا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The Status of the Lowest people in paradise
chapters.name_ar: باب أَدْنَى أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلَةً فِيهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Regarding the saying of the Prophet (saws): "I will be the first of the people to intercede concerning Paradise, and I will be the Prophet with the Greatest Number of Followers."
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي قَوْلِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَنَا أَوَّلُ النَّاسِ يَشْفَعُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَأَنَا أَكْثَرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ تَبَعًا»

chapters.name_en: The Prophet (saws) will defer his supplication in order to intercede for his ummah
chapters.name_ar: باب اخْتِبَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعْوَةَ الشَّفَاعَةِ لأُمَّتِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The supplication of the Prophet (saws) for his ummah and his weeping out of compassion for them
chapters.name_ar: باب دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُمَّتِهِ وَبُكَائِهِ شَفَقَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that whoever died upon disbelief then he is in the Fire, and no intercession or relationship with those who are close to Allah will be of any avail for him
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ مَنْ مَاتَ عَلَى الْكُفْرِ فَهُوَ فِي النَّارِ وَلاَ تَنَالُهُ شَفَاعَةٌ وَلاَ تَنْفَعُهُ قَرَابَةُ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ

chapters.name_en: Regarding the saying of Allah, the most High: "And warn your tribe of near kindred."
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {وَأَنْذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ الأَقْرَبِينَ}

chapters.name_en: The Intercession of the Prophet (saws) for Abu Talib and the reduction of his punishment as a result
chapters.name_ar: باب شَفَاعَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَبِي طَالِبٍ وَالتَّخْفِيفِ عَنْهُ بِسَبَبِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The least severely punished of the people of the Fire
chapters.name_ar: باب أَهْوَنِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence that whoever dies upon disbelief, no good deed will benefit him
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ علَى أَنَّ مَنْ مَاتَ عَلَى الْكُفْرِ لاَ يَنْفَعُهُ عَمَلٌ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Allegiance to the believers, and forsaking others and disavowing them
chapters.name_ar: باب مُوَالاَةِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَمُقَاطَعَةِ غَيْرِهِمْ وَالْبَرَاءَةِ مِنْهُمْ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The Evidence that groups of Muslims will enter Paradise without being called to account, and without being punished
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى دُخُولِ طَوَائِفَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْجَنَّةَ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ وَلاَ عَذَابٍ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Clarifying that this ummah will form half of the People of Paradise
chapters.name_ar: باب كَوْنِ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ نِصْفَ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Allah will say to Adam: "Bring out the Portion of the Fire; Nine Hundred and Ninety-Nine Out of Every Thousand."
chapters.name_ar: باب قَوْلِهِ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ لِآدَمَ أَخْرِجْ بَعْثَ النَّارِ مِنْ كُلِّ أَلْفٍ تِسْعَ مِائَةٍ وَتِسْعَةً وَتِسْعِينَ

chapters.name_en: The virtue of wudu’
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ الْوُضُوءِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The obligation of purifying oneself for the salat
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ الطَّهَارَةِ لِلصَّلاَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The description of wudu’ and its perfection
chapters.name_ar: باب صِفَةِ الْوُضُوءِ وَكَمَالِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of performing wudu’ and salat
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ الْوُضُوءِ وَالصَّلاَةِ عَقِبَهُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The five daily prayers, from one Jumu`ah to the next, and from one Ramadan to the next, are an expiation for whatever (sins) come in between, so long as one avoids major sins
chapters.name_ar: باب الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَمَضَانُ إِلَى رَمَضَانَ مُكَفِّرَاتٌ لِمَا بَيْنَهُنَّ مَا اجْتُنِبَتِ الْكَبَائِرُ.

chapters.name_en: Adh-Dhikr (the remembrance) which is recommended following wudu’
chapters.name_ar: باب الذِّكْرِ الْمُسْتَحَبِّ عَقِبَ الْوُضُوءِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Another description of wudu’
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي وُضُوءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Odd numbers when rinsing the nose and cleaning  oneself with pebbles (istijmar)

chapters.name_ar: باب السِّوَاكِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The characteristics of the fitrah
chapters.name_ar: باب خِصَالِ الْفِطْرَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Starting on the right when purifying oneself and in other matters

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of relieving oneself in the street or in the shade
chapters.name_ar: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ التَّخَلِّي، فِي الطُّرُقِ وَالظِّلاَلِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Cleaning oneself with water after defecating
chapters.name_ar: باب الاِسْتِنْجَاءِ بِالْمَاءِ مِنَ التَّبَرُّزِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Wiping over the forehead and the imamah
chapters.name_ar: باب الْمَسْحِ عَلَى النَّاصِيَةِ وَالْعِمَامَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ الصَّلَوَاتِ كُلِّهَا بِوُضُوءٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is disliked for the person who wants to perform wudu’, and others, to put his hand in the vessel (containing water) before washing it three times, if he is not sure whether something impure is on his hands or not
chapters.name_ar: باب كَرَاهَةِ غَمْسِ الْمُتَوَضِّئِ وَغَيْرِهِ يَدَهُ الْمَشْكُوكَ فِي نَجَاسَتِهَا فِي الإِنَاءِ قَبْلَ غَسْلِهَا ثَلاَثًا

chapters.name_ar: باب حُكْمِ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of urinating into standing water
chapters.name_ar: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ، فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Prohibition of performing ghusl in standing water
chapters.name_ar: باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ الاِغْتِسَالِ، فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The obligation to wash away urine and other impurities if they result in the Masjid, and the ground may be purified with water with no need to scrub it
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ غَسْلِ الْبَوْلِ وَغَيْرِهِ مِنَ النَّجَاسَاتِ إِذَا حَصُلَتْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَأَنَّ الأَرْضَ تَطْهُرُ بِالْمَاءِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَاجَةٍ إِلَى حَفْرِهَا

chapters.name_ar: باب حُكْمِ بَوْلِ الطِّفْلِ الرَّضِيعِ وَكَيْفِيَّةِ غَسْلِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The ruling on semen
chapters.name_ar: باب حكْمِ الْمَنِيِّ ‏

chapters.name_en: The impurity of blood and how to wash it
chapters.name_ar: باب نَجَاسَةِ الدَّمِ وَكَيْفِيَّةِ غَسْلِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence that urine is impure and the obligation to take precautions concerning it
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى نَجَاسَةِ الْبَوْلِ وَوُجُوبِ الاِسْتِبْرَاءِ مِنْهُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Touching a menstruating woman above the izar (waist wrapper)
chapters.name_ar: باب مُبَاشَرَةِ الْحَائِضِ فَوْقَ الإِزَارِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Lying down with a menstruating woman under a single cover
chapters.name_ar: باب الاِضْطِجَاعِ مَعَ الْحَائِضِ فِي لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Madhi (prostatic fluid)
chapters.name_ar: باب الْمَذْىِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Washing the face and hands when waking from sleep
chapters.name_ar: باب غَسْلِ الْوَجْهِ وَالْيَدَيْنِ إِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنَ النَّوْمِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible for one who is junub to sleep, but it is recommended for him to perform wudu’, and wash his private parts if he wants to eat, drink, sleep, or have intercourse
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ نَوْمِ الْجُنُبِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ الْوُضُوءِ لَهُ وَغَسْلِ الْفَرْجِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ أَوْ يَشْرَبَ أَوْ يَنَامَ أَوْ يُجَامِعَل

chapters.name_en: Women are obliged to perform ghusl if they emit fluid
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ الْغُسْلِ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ بِخُرُوجِ الْمَنِيِّ مِنْهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Description of the (fluid) of the man and the woman; the child is created from the water of both of them
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ صِفَةِ مَنِيِّ الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَأَنَّ الْوَلَدَ مَخْلُوقٌ مِنْ مَائِهِمَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Description of ghusl in the case of janabah (sexual impurity)
chapters.name_ar: باب صِفَةِ غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The amount of water with which it is recommended to perform ghusl in the case of janabah; a man and woman washing from a single vessel; one of them washing with the left-over water of the other
chapters.name_ar: باب الْقَدْرِ الْمُسْتَحَبِّ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فِي غُسْلِ الْجَنَابَةِ وَغُسْلِ الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ فِي إِنَاءٍ وَاحِدٍ فِي حَالَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ وَغُسْلِ أَحَدِهِمَا بِفَضْلِ الآخَرِ

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pour water over the head, and elsewhere, three times
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ إِفَاضَةِ الْمَاءِ عَلَى الرَّأْسِ وَغَيْرِهِ ثَلاَثًا ‏

chapters.name_en: Ruling on the braids of a woman who is doing ghusl
chapters.name_ar: باب حُكْمِ ضَفَائِرِ الْمُغْتَسِلَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended for the woman who is performing ghusl following menses to apply a piece of cloth scented with musk to the site of the bleeding
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ اسْتِعْمَالِ الْمُغْتَسِلَةِ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ فِرْصَةً مِنْ مِسْكٍ فِي مَوْضِعِ الدَّمِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The ghusl and the prayer of a woman who is suffering prolonged vaginal bleeding (istihadah)
chapters.name_ar: باب الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ وَغُسْلِهَا وَصَلاَتِهَا ‏

chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ قَضَاءِ الصَّوْمِ عَلَى الْحَائِضِ دُونَ الصَّلاَةِ ‏

chapters.name_ar: باب تَسَتُّرِ الْمُغْتَسِلِ بِثَوْبٍ وَنَحْوِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of looking at `awrah
chapters.name_ar: باب تَحْرِيمِ النَّظَرِ إِلَى الْعَوْرَاتِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to bathe naked when one is alone
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ الاِغْتِسَالِ عُرْيَانًا فِي الْخَلْوَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Taking care to conceal one’s `awrah
chapters.name_ar: باب الاِعْتِنَاءِ بِحِفْظِ الْعَوْرَةِ

chapters.name_en: Screening oneself when urinating
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا يُسْتَتَرُ بِهِ لِقَضَاءِ الْحَاجَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: At the beginning of Islam, intercourse did not necessitate ghusl unless semen was emitted, then that was abrogated and ghusl becomes obligatory for intercourse
chapters.name_ar: باب إِنَّمَا الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Abrogation of “water is for water”, and that it is obligatory to perform ghusl when the two circumcised parts meet
chapters.name_ar: باب نَسْخِ ‏"‏ الْمَاءُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏وَوُجُوبِ الْغُسْلِ بِالْتِقَاءِ الْخِتَانَيْنِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Performing wudu’ after eating something that has been touched by fire
chapters.name_ar: باب الْوُضُوءِ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏

chapters.name_en: Abrogation of wudu’ for that which has been touched by fire
chapters.name_ar: باب نَسْخِ ‏"‏ الْوُضُوءِ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏

chapters.name_en: (Performing) wudu’ after eating camel meat
chapters.name_ar: باب الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ لُحُومِ الإِبِلِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Evidence that if a person is certain that he is in a state of purity, then he doubts whether he has committed hadith (broken his wudu’), then he prays with his purity like that
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ مَنْ تَيَقَّنَ الطَّهَارَةَ ثُمَّ شَكَّ فِي الْحَدَثِ فَلَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ بِطَهَارَتِهِ تِلْكَ

chapters.name_en: Hides of dead animals are purified by tanning
chapters.name_ar: باب طَهَارَةِ جُلُودِ الْمَيْتَةِ بِالدِّبَاغِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Tayammum
chapters.name_ar: باب التَّيَمُّمِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Evidence that the Muslim does not become impure
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ لاَ يَنْجُسُ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Remembering Allah, the Most High, when one is sexually impure, and at other times
chapters.name_ar: باب ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فِي حَالِ الْجَنَابَةِ وَغَيْرِهَا ‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible for one who has broken his wudu’ to eat, and there is nothing disliked about doing so, and wudu’ need not be done immediately
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ أَكْلِ الْمُحْدِثِ الطَّعَامَ وَأَنَّهُ لاَ كَرَاهَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ وَأَنَّ الْوُضُوءَ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْفَوْرِ

chapters.name_en: What should be said when entering the area in which one relieves himself
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا أَرَادَ دُخُولَ الْخَلاَءِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Evidence that sleeping while sitting does not invalidate wudu’
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ عَلَى أَنَّ نَوْمَ الْجَالِسِ لاَ يَنْقُضُ الْوُضُوءَ ‏

chapters.name_en: The Beginning Of The Adhan
chapters.name_ar: باب بَدْءِ الأَذَانِ

chapters.name_en: The Command to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the iqamah once, except the phrase, "Prayer is about to begin," which is to be said twice
chapters.name_ar: باب الأَمْرِ بِشَفْعِ الأَذَانِ وَإِيتَارِ الإِقَامَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Description Of The Adhan
chapters.name_ar: باب صِفَةِ الأَذَانِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It Is Recommended To Have Two Mu'adhdhin In A Single Masjid
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ اتِّخَاذِ مُؤَذِّنَيْنِ لِلْمَسْجِدِ الْوَاحِدِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It Is Permissible For A Blind Man To Call The Adhan So long As There Is A Man With Him Who Sees
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ أَذَانِ الأَعْمَى إِذَا كَانَ مَعَهُ بَصِيرٌ ‏

chapters.name_en: Refraining From Attacking People In Dar Al-Kufr (Non-Muslim Lands) If The Adhan Is Heard Among Them
chapters.name_ar: باب الإِمْسَاكِ عَنِ الإِغَارَةِ، عَلَى قَوْمٍ فِي دَارِ الْكُفْرِ إِذَا سُمِعَ فِيهِمُ الأَذَانُ ‏

chapters.name_en: It Is Recommended For The One Who Hears The Mu'adhdhin To Repeat His Words, Then To Send Salat Upon The Prophet (saws) And Ask Allah To Grant Him Al-Wasilah
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ الْقَوْلِ مِثْلَ قَوْلِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ لِمَنْ سَمِعَهُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَهُ الْوَسِيلَةَ

chapters.name_en: The Virtue Of the Adhan, And The Shaitan Flees When He Hears It
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ الأَذَانِ وَهَرَبِ الشَّيْطَانِ عِنْدَ سَمَاعِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It Is Recommended To Raise The Hands Level With The Shoulders When Saying The Opening Takbir, When Bowing And When Rising From Bowing. But That Is Not To Be Done When Rising From The Prostration
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ حَذْوَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ مَعَ تَكْبِيرَةِ الإِحْرَامِ وَالرُّكُوعِ وَفِي الرَّفْعِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَأَنَّهُ لاَ يَفْعَلُهُ إِذَا رَفَعَ مِنَ السُّجُودِ

chapters.name_en: Affirming The Takbir For Every Movement Up Or Down In The Prayer, Except When Rising From Ruku' When One Should Say: Sami'aAllahu Liman Hamidah (Allah Hears Those Who Praise Him)
chapters.name_ar: باب إِثْبَاتِ التَّكْبِيرِ فِي كُلِّ خَفْضٍ وَرَفْعٍ فِي الصَّلاَةِ إِلاَّ رَفْعَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَيَقُولُ فِيهِ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ

chapters.name_en: It Is Obligatory To Recite Al-Fatihah In Every Rak'ah; If A Person Cannot Recite Al-Fatihah Or Cannot Learn It, Then He Should Recite Whatever Else He Can Manage
chapters.name_ar: باب وُجُوبِ قِرَاءَةِ الْفَاتِحَةِ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ وَإِنَّهُ إِذَا لَمْ يُحْسِنِ الْفَاتِحَةَ وَلاَ أَمْكَنَهُ تَعَلُّمُهَا قَرَأَ مَا تَيَسَّرَ لَهُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا

chapters.name_en: Prohibiting The Follower From Reciting Aloud Behind An Imam
chapters.name_ar: باب نَهْىِ الْمَأْمُومِ عَنْ جَهْرِهِ، بِالْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ إِمَامِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The Proof Of Those Who Say That The Basmalah Should Not Be Recited Aloud
chapters.name_ar: باب حُجَّةِ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ يَجْهَرُ بِالْبَسْمَلَةِ ‏

chapters.name_ar: باب الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to seek refuge with Allah from the punishment of the grave, the punishment of hell, the trials of life and death, the tribulation of the Dajjal and from sin and debt between the tashah-hud and the taslim
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ التَّعَوُّذِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏

chapters.name_en: From what refuge is to be sought when in salat
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا يُسْتَعَاذُ مِنْهُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to recite statements of remembrance after the prayer, and how that is to be done
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ وَبَيَان صِفَتِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: What is to be said between the opening takbir and the recitation of the Qur’an
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا يُقَالُ بَيْنَ تَكْبِيرَةِ الإِحْرَامِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to come to prayers in a tranquil and dignified manner, and it is forbidden to come in a hasty manner
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ إِتْيَانِ الصَّلاَةِ بِوَقَارٍ وَسَكِينَةٍ وَالنَّهْىِ عَنْ إِتْيَانِهَا سَعْيًا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: When should the people stand up to pray?
chapters.name_ar: باب مَتَى يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِلصَّلاَةِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The one who catches up with a rak`ah of the prayer, he has caught up with that prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ تِلْكَ الصَّلاَةَ ‏

chapters.name_en: The times of the five prayers
chapters.name_ar: باب أَوْقَاتِ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The recommendation to delay Zuhr (until it has cooled down) in severe heat for one who finds it too hot in route to join the congregation
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ الإِبْرَادِ بِالظُّهْرِ فِي شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ لِمَنْ يَمْضِي إِلَى جَمَاعَةٍ وَيَنَالُهُ الْحَرُّ فِي طَرِيقِهِ

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray Zuhr at the beginning of its time when there is no intense heat
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَقْدِيمِ الظُّهْرِ فِي أَوَّلِ الْوَقْتِ فِي غَيْرِ شِدَّةِ الْحَرِّ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray `Asr early
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ التَّبْكِيرِ بِالْعَصْرِ

chapters.name_en: Stern warning against missing the `Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب التَّغْلِيظِ فِي تَفْوِيتِ صَلاَةِ الْعَصْرِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The evidence for those who say that “the middle prayer” is the `Asr prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب الدَّلِيلِ لِمَنْ قَالَ الصَّلاَةُ الْوُسْطَى هِيَ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of the Subh and the `Asr prayers, and of maintaining them
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ صَلاَتَىِ الصُّبْحِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَيْهِمَا ‏

chapters.name_en: The beginning of the time for Maghrib when the sun sets
chapters.name_ar: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ أَوَّلَ وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The time of `Isha and delaying it
chapters.name_ar: باب وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ وَتَأْخِيرِهَا ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray Subh early, at the beginning of its time, when it is still dark; and the length of recitation therein
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ التَّبْكِيرِ بِالصُّبْحِ فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا وَهُوَ التَّغْلِيسُ وَبَيَانِ قَدْرِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِيهَا

chapters.name_en: It is disliked to delay the prayers beyond their proper times, and what a person should do if the Imam delays the prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب كَرَاهِيَةِ تَأْخِيرِ الصَّلاَةِ عَنْ وَقْتِهَا الْمُخْتَارِ وَمَا يَفْعَلُهُ الْمَأْمُومُ إِذَا أَخَّرَهَا الإِمَامُ

chapters.name_en: The virtue of prayer in congregation, and clarifying the stern warning against staying away from it, and that it is fard kifayah
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الجَمَاعَةِ وَبَيَانِ التَّشْدِيدِ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنْهَا ‏

chapters.name_en: It is obligatory for the one who hears the call to prayer to come to the masjid
chapters.name_ar: باب يَجِبُ إِتْيَانُ الْمَسْجِدِ عَلَى مَنْ سَمِعَ النِّدَاءَ ‏

chapters.name_en: Prayer in congregation is one of the sunnah of guidance
chapters.name_ar: باب صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ مِنْ سُنَنِ الْهُدَى ‏

chapters.name_en: The prohibition of leaving the masjid once the Mu’adhdhin has called the Adhan
chapters.name_ar: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الْخُرُوجِ، مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ إِذَا أَذَّنَ الْمُؤَذِّنُ ‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of praying `Isha and Subh in congregation
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْعِشَاءِ وَالصُّبْحِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Concession allowing one to not attend the congregation if there is an excuse
chapters.name_ar: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنِ الْجَمَاعَةِ، بِعُذْرٍ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to offer voluntary prayers in congregation, and to pray on hasir (palm-fiber mats), khumrah (small mats), cloth, and other pure things
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ الْجَمَاعَةِ فِي النَّافِلَةِ وَالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى حَصِيرٍ وَخُمْرَةٍ وَثَوْبٍ وَغَيْرِهَا مِنَ الطَّاهِرَاتِ

chapters.name_en: The virtue of offering the obligatory prayers in congregation, the virtue of waiting for prayer and taking many steps towards the masjid, the virtue of walking to the masjid
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ صَلاَةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ وَانْتِظَارِ الصَّلاَةِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of taking many steps to the masjid
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ كَثْرَةِ الْخُطَا إِلَى الْمَسَاجِدِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Walking to prayer erases sins and raises one in status
chapters.name_ar: باب الْمَشْىُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ تُمْحَى بِهِ الْخَطَايَا وَتُرْفَعُ بِهِ الدَّرَجَاتُ ‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of sitting in one’s prayer place after Subh, and the virtue of the masajid
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ الْجُلُوسِ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ وَفَضْلِ الْمَسَاجِدِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Who is more entitled to lead the prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِالإِمَامَةِ

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to say qunut in all prayers if a calamity befalls the Muslims – and refuge is sought from Allah (regarding that). It is recommended to say qunut in Subh at all times. And the clarification that it is to be said after raising the head from bowing in the final rak`ah, and it is recommended to say it out loud
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ الْقُنُوتِ فِي جَمِيعِ الصَّلاَةِ إِذَا نزَلَتْ بِالْمُسْلِمِينَ نَازِلَةٌ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Making up a missed prayer. And it is recommended to hasten to make it up
chapters.name_ar: باب قَضَاءِ الصَّلاَةِ الْفَائِتَةِ وَاسْتِحْبَابِ تَعْجِيلِ قَضَائِهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The travelers’ prayer and shortening it
chapters.name_ar: باب صَلاَةِ الْمُسَافِرِينَ وَقَصْرِهَا ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Shortening the prayer in Mina
chapters.name_ar: باب قَصْرِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمِنًى ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Praying in dwellings when it is raining
chapters.name_ar: باب الصَّلاَةِ فِي الرحَالِ فِي الْمَطَرِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to offer voluntary prayers atop one’s mount when travelling, no matter what direction it is facing
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ صَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ عَلَى الدَّابَّةِ فِي السَّفَرِ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to combine two prayers when traveling
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Joining two prayers when not traveling
chapters.name_ar: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to leave to the right or left after finishing the prayer
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَاز الاِنْصِرَافِ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ، وَالشِّمَالِ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to stand to the right of the Imam
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ يَمِينِ الإِمَامِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is disliked to start a voluntary prayer after the Mu’adhdhin has started to say Iqamah for prayer, whether that is a regular sunnah, such as the sunnah of Subh or Zuhr, or anything else, and regardless of whether he knows that he will catch up with the rak`ah with the Imam or not
chapters.name_ar: باب كَرَاهَةِ الشُّرُوعِ فِي نَافِلَةٍ بَعْدَ شُرُوعِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ ‏

chapters.name_en: What to say when entering the masjid
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا يَقُولُ إِذَا دَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to greet the masjid by praying two rak`ah, and it is disliked to sit before praying these two rak`ah, and this is prescribed at all times
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَحِيَّةِ الْمَسْجِدِ بِرَكْعَتَيْنِ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْجُلُوسِ قَبْلَ صَلاَتِهِمَا وَأَنَّهَا مَشْرُوعَةٌ فِي جَمِيعِ الأَوْقَاتِ

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray two rak`ah in the masjid for one who has come from a journey, when he first arrives
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِمَنْ قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ أَوَّلَ قُدُومِهِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray Duha, the least of which is two rak`ah, the best of which is eight, and the average of which is four or six, and encouragement to do so regularly
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ صَلاَةِ الضُّحَى وَأَنَّ أَقَلَّهَا رَكْعَتَانِ وَأَكْمَلَهَا ثَمَانِ رَكَعَاتٍ وَأَوْسَطَهَا أَرْبَعُ رَكَعَاتٍ أَوْ سِتٌّ وَالْحَثِّ عَلَى الْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَيْهَا

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to pray two rak`ah for the sunnah of Fajr. And encouragement to pray them regularly, and to make them brief, and to persist in offering them, and clarifying what is recommended to recite therein
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ رَكْعَتَيْ سُنَّةِ الْفَجْرِ وَالْحَثِّ عَلَيْهِمَا وَتَخْفِيفِهِمَا وَالْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَيْهِمَا وَبَيَانِ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ أَنْ يُقْرَأَ فِيهِمَا

chapters.name_en: The virtue of the regular sunnah prayers before and after the obligatory prayers, and their numbers
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضْلِ السُّنَنِ الرَّاتِبَةِ قَبْلَ الْفَرَائِضِ وَبَعْدَهُنَّ وَبَيَانِ عَدَدِهِنَّ

chapters.name_en: It is permissible to offer voluntary prayers standing or sitting, and to stand and sit in the same rak`ah
chapters.name_ar: باب جَوَازِ النَّافِلَةِ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا وَفِعْلِ بَعْضِ الرَّكْعَةِ قَائِمًا وَبَعْضِهَا قَاعِدًا ‏

chapters.name_en: Night prayers and the number of rak`ah offered by the Prophet (saws) at night, and that Witr is one rak`ah, and a one-rak`ah prayer is correct
chapters.name_ar: باب صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَعَدَدِ رَكَعَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي اللَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ الْوِتْرَ رَكْعَةٌ وَأَنَّ الرَّكْعَةَ صَلاَةٌ صَحِيحَةٌ

chapters.name_en: Night prayer, and the one who sleeps and misses it or is sick
chapters.name_ar: باب جَامِعِ صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَمَنْ نَامَ عَنْهُ أَوْ مَرِضَ ‏

chapters.name_en: Salat al-Awwabin (the prayer of the penitent) is when the young camels feel the heat of the hot sand
chapters.name_ar: باب صَلاَةُ الأَوَّابِينَ حِينَ تَرْمَضُ الْفِصَالُ ‏

chapters.name_en: The night prayers are two by two, and Witr is one rakah at the end of the night
chapters.name_ar: باب صَلاَةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَالْوِتْرُ رَكْعَةٌ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ ‏

chapters.name_en: One who fears that he will not get up at the end of the night, then he should pray Witr at the beginning of the night
chapters.name_ar: باب مَنْ خَافَ أَنْ لاَ يَقُومَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ فَلْيُوتِرْ أَوَّلَهُ ‏

chapters.name_en: The best prayer is that in which one stands for a long time (tuwlul-qunut)
chapters.name_ar: باب أَفْضَلُ الصَّلاَةِ طُولُ الْقُنُوتِ ‏

chapters.name_en: In the night there is an hour when supplications are answered
chapters.name_ar: باب فِي اللَّيْلِ سَاعَةٌ مُسْتَجَابٌ فِيهَا الدُّعَاءُ ‏

chapters.name_en: Encouragement to supplicate and recite statements of remembrance at the end of the night, and the response to that
chapters.name_ar: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ وَالذِّكْرِ فِي آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ وَالإِجَابَةِ فِيهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Encouragement to pray qiyam during Ramadan, which is Tarawih
chapters.name_ar: باب التَّرْغِيبِ فِي قِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ وَهُوَ التَّرَاوِيحُ ‏

chapters.name_en: The prayer and the supplication of the Prophet (saws) at night
chapters.name_ar: باب الدُّعَاءِ فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ وَقِيَامِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to recite for a long time in the night prayers
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَطْوِيلِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي صَلاَةِ اللَّيْلِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: Encouragement to pray at night even if it is little
chapters.name_ar: باب مَا رُوِيَ فِيمَنْ، نَامَ اللَّيْلَ أَجْمَعَ حَتَّى أَصْبَحَ ‏

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to offer voluntary prayers in one’s house although it is permissible to offer them in the masjid, whether that is a regular voluntary prayer or any other, except for the public ritual prayers, namely, `Id prayer, the eclipse prayer, prayers for rain and Tarawih, and prayers that can only be offered in the masjid, such as greeting the masjid, and prayers that are recommended to be offered in the masjid, namely the two rak`ah following tawaf
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ صَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَجَوَازِهَا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The virtue of a deed that is done persistently, whether it be Qiyam al-Lail or anything else. The command to be moderate in worship, which means adopting what one can persist in. The command to the one who gets tired or weary when praying  to stop until that feeling passes
chapters.name_ar: باب فَضِيلَةِ الْعَمَلِ الدَّائِمِ مِنْ قِيَامِ اللَّيْلِ وَغَيْرِهِ ‏

chapters.name_en: The command to one who becomes sleepy while praying, or who starts to falter in his recitation of the Qur’an or statements of remembrance, to lie down or sit down until that goes away
chapters.name_ar: باب أَمْرِ مَنْ نَعَسَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ أَوِ اسْتَعْجَمَ عَلَيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ أَوِ الذِّكْرُ بِأَنْ يَرْقُدَ أَوْ يَقْعُدَ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ عَنْهُ ذَلِكَ

chapters.name_en: The command to keep refreshing one’s knowledge of the Qur’an and that it is disliked to say I have forgotten such-and-such a verse, but it is permissible to say I have been caused to forget
chapters.name_ar: باب الأَمْرِ بِتَعَهُّدِ الْقُرْآنِ وَكَرَاهَةِ قَوْلِ نَسِيتُ آيَةَ كَذَا. وَجَوَازِ قَوْلِ أُنْسِيتُهَا

chapters.name_en: It is recommended to make one’s voice beautiful when reciting Qur’an
chapters.name_ar: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ تَحْسِينِ الصَّوْتِ بِالْقُرْآنِ ‏

chapters.name_en: Mentioning the recitation of the Prophet (saws) of Surat al-Fath on the day of the conquest of Makkah
chapters.name_ar: باب ذِكْرِ قِرَاءَةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُورَةَ الْفَتْحِ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ ‏‏

chapters.name_en: The descent of tranquility (sakinah) when the Qur’an is recited
